subject: I Never Wanted to Work for the Federal Government Again...
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Judge for Congress
body:

---
[](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=4930e103c4&e=00028e5542)
|
**I Never Wanted to Work for the Federal Government Again...**
---
|
Fellow Patriot,
I have served proudly in the U.S. Coast Guard and worked for the Department of Defense. Between the two, I served our country in both Iraq and Afghanistan.
---
[](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=1e67854f76&e=00028e5542)
| I had the time of my life in the military, but when I came back to the Tampa Bay area where I was born and raised, I started a small business and never thought I’d work for the federal government again.
But seeing how badly our “leaders” in Washington are doing, I felt called once again to work for the federal government - this time on your behalf in U.S. Congress.
To be honest, I thought I’d be fighting with Democrats most of the time, but then I learned a tough lesson:** the RINOs in Congress are worse than the Democrats.**
---
[DONATE NOW](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=2255467727&e=00028e5542)
|
The uniparty RINOs, like my opponent Laurel Lee, have conserved** NOTHING** over the past 40 years.
Now that I’ve learned this, I’m even more motivated to get to Washington and set the Republican Party straight while I fight for you, and for our conservative values.
[**That’s why I need your help today.**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=777cdf1b2c&e=00028e5542)****
I have 42 days left to defeat my RINO opponent, who takes vast amounts of money from Big Tech Companies who hate and censor conservatives. She votes in lockstep with Democrats on massive spending bills, and she was even denounced by President Trump for her failures to put America First.
[**We are making steady progress towards our goal of raising $50,000 before August 13 to spend on television and radio ads, but we need your financial help right away**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=de11d71940&e=00028e5542).
My RINO opponent Laurel Lee has a **MASSIVE WAR CHEST,** but we have a better ground game, and are talking to voters who want real change every day.
[**That’s why whatever you can contribute, even if it’s only $10, $25, or $50, will go a long way in helping me get elected so I can fight on your behalf for real conservative principles and to put America First**](https://judgeforcongress.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=2ecfd6049e&e=00028e5542)**.**
Thank you in advance for your generosity.
For God and Country,
---
| James Judge
America-First ConservativeCandidate for U.S. Congress (FL-15)
U.S. Coast Guard Veteran
*Operation Iraqi Freedom 2004-2005*Operation Enduring Freedom 2010-2011
---

name: Jim Carris
subject: Carris for Congress Weekly Update
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Carris for Congress
body:
No images? [Click here](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-e-ekhuyjy-tlidtddjku-n/) Team Carris,

I hope you and your loved ones had a safe and joyous Fourth of July! Spending Independence Day and this past weekend walking in parades across our district was an inspiring experience that deepened my pride in our country, the 10th District and all of our communities. On the Fourth of July in **Lake Bluff** , the parade was a vibrant celebration of local and national pride. As I marched alongside local leaders, wonderful community organizations, and families, I felt a profound connection to the spirit of our nation. The cheers and waves from the crowd reinforced my belief in the importance of preserving our most beloved traditions and ensuring every voice in our community is heard. Being able to walk in my hometown parade was incredibly special to my family and me!As the day unfolded, our team joined parades in Vernon Hills, Winnetka, Deerfield, Highland Park and Northbrook! Each parade was a testament to the unique character and unity of these communities.
* In **Vernon Hills** , multigenerational families reflected the core values that make our District special - love for who we come from and love for those who will carry our legacy on in the future
* In **Deerfield** , the parade route was lined with families proudly displaying the American flag, a reminder of the shared values that bind us together
* In **Winnetka** (one of the furthest South communities in our District and a community new to District 10), families were excited to learn that a new candidate for office was committed to making sure their needs are being heard in Washington
* In **Northbrook** , we were surrounded by local veterans and first responders who highlighted the sacrifices made for our freedoms and the strength of our local heroes.
* In **Highland Park** , a resilient community showed that united together, the memory of those we lost two years ago to senseless violence continues to live on. I will never forget the sincere faces and spirit of strength I experienced as we greeted people and walked the parade route

These parades were not just celebrations but affirmations of our collective dedication to the ideals of liberty and justice for all.
We continued Independence Day celebrations with parades in Hebron, Wonder Lake, and Mundelein, each showcasing the deep-rooted patriotism of our District.
* In **Hebron** (one of the furthest West communities in our District), the parade was a colorful display of community spirit, with children and adults alike proudly waving flags. Hebron's small-town parade offered a chance to connect closely with residents, celebrating the rural heart of our District.
* **Wonder Lake** 's parade along the waterfront emphasized the natural beauty we must preserve in our lakes system and the strength of small and local businesses in our communities. The turnout was amazing!
* **Mundelein** 's afternoon parade was a fitting end to a week and weekend filled with pride and unity. The hearty spirit of parade goers was a testament to our American resilience as we experienced a steady downpour during the whole parade. It was actually very fun!

Walking in these parades, surrounded by the unwavering spirit of our communities, reinforced my commitment to serving and advocating for every resident of our district! Jim Carris
Candidate for Congress **#HighlandParkStrong** As we gathered to celebrate the Fourth of July in our communities and across #IL10, this day holds a somber memory for our Highland Park neighbors and friends. Two years ago, a senseless act of violence shook our community to its core. Every July Fourth, we must honor and remember the lives lost and the families forever changed by this tragedy and ensure it never happens again. **On the Road in #IL10** 🇺🇸 **Promoting Participation in and Support of Our Local Townships**
Thank you to the Republicans of Wheeling and Palatine Townships for hosting us at the 2024 Northwest Suburban Lincoln Day Dinner featuring keynote speaker Stephen Moore and Master of Ceremonies, Joseph A. Morris! We had the honor of having Senator Mark Kirk join us for dinner and I was proud to break bread with one of our state's finest public servants. It was a wonderful evening with friends and party leaders! 🇺🇸 **Connecting with Voters and Supporters in Long Grove**
I was overjoyed to share the stage with outstanding fellow candidates Mary Cole for State's Attorney and Mark Symonds for Lake County Coroner in Long Grove while speaking with residents from all over #IL10. We talked about the importance of getting out the vote, encouraging voters to register and bank their vote along with issues like the rise in crime, the fentanyl crisis, and support for common sense policies. 🇺🇸 **Celebrating Libertyville During Libertyville Days!**
Thank you to Mayor Donna Johnson and the families of Libertyville for making us feel so welcome at the Libertyville Days Festival parade! Our Team Carris volunteers had a great time handing out candy, meeting residents, and shaking hands with voters many of whom had lived in the area for generations and care deeply about the future of their hometown in #IL10. Libertyville is a wonderful community! 🇺🇸 **Supporting Small Business in Hebron**
Thank you to Chef Matt from Hart's Saloon in Hebron for hosting our team for homemade pizza in between parades! If you're in the area, make sure to support Matt and his team who love their community and walked with us in the Fourth of July parade! 🇺🇸 **Creating Memories with the Carris Family**
As I've mentioned before, running for office is a family affair in our home and last week, in a short break from the campaign trail, my wife Kimberly and I made memories with our son Gus in Cooperstown, New York. As the home of baseball, Cooperstown participants develop an appreciation for tradition, values of faith, country, and baseball. Gus and his 12U teammates learned that the greatest players have a .300 batting average, meaning they fail 7 out of 10 times and they are still the greatest, which is a message that Cooperstown inculcates in their players - to chase their dreams and never give up. We are so proud of him! Are you interested in hosting a meet and greet for Team Carris or inviting Jim to your event? Email us at info@carrisforcongress.com! **Join Team Carris** We need your help! Join our team to make a difference by attending events, connecting with neighbors and constituents around the District, and sharing information with your network. [Click Here to Sign Up to Volunteer](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhuyjy-tlidtddjku-r/) **Request a Yard Sign**
Spread the word about Team Carris in your neighborhood! If you would like one of our team members to drop of a sign(s), please fill out the form below by clicking the button! [Click Here to Request a Sign](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhuyjy-tlidtddjku-y/) **Follow Carris for Congress on Social Media** **Post of the Week:**
If you haven't already, make sure to follow [@studentsforcarris_](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhuyjy-tlidtddjku-j/) on Instagram! Our amazing interns and volunteers are sharing their life on the campaign trail and the fun that they're having throughout the District. Do you want to stay in touch and follow Jim throughout the 10th District? Make sure to follow us on social media to learn about Jim's platform and to get to know the District through his experience meeting local residents, supporting small businesses and local organizations, and learning about how #IL10 families really want their representative to vote in Washington. **Click Below to Follow** [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhuyjy-tlidtddjku-t/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhuyjy-tlidtddjku-i/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhuyjy-tlidtddjku-d/)
**Share with Your Friends!**
We also need your help! You can download the Social Media Toolkit below to share your support with your network on your favorite social media channels. Create a post today and don't forget to tag us and use #carrisforcongress. We will share our favorite posts! [Click Here to Download](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ekhuyjy-tlidtddjku-h/) **Support Carris for Congress** Jim is on a mission to bring independence, compassion, and common sense to Washington. Your continued financial support will help us reach more voters through our grassroots organizing efforts. Together, we can secure a win for Illinois and for our country by sending Jim to our nation's capital! body:
C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7aim7kti0fsa6ol1ihcgtlrjl942oorn3nlk4a0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cdg6eob6c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I hope you are having a fine day so far. Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News_ because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—like our free online courses. __ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author—C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **“[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z9nqrs8hnmvadj3is9u0bgkbcou4ipnk8418mja0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cdg6eob6c1h2bs)” **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z8qsgpdlgneh67qvn1qtkdpgn1nafp3jbdcmsu40_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cdg6eob6c1h2bs),” **we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zr1aebel73bo23i58t4melea80465vaj7s8ujhgo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cdg6eob6c1h2bs) We’ve also heard from many of our friends that they would love to own a DVD version. So, I’m pleased to announce that the C.S. Lewis course is available on DVD for your home library. You can also give it as a gift or use it in a small group, such as a Bible study or book club. We only made a few of these special sets, so get this premium edition of **“[An Introduction to C.S. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won’t last long. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News_ because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—like our free online courses. __ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author—C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. name: Freedom First Project
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._8gbMINeGfEmpZ1qNXgvA) For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history.

Thanks for opening my email. Today, I’m writing to let you know about a special offer for you from Hillsdale College, a private, fiercely independent, conservative college located in south-central Michigan where I work. You may have heard of us on talk radio, social media, YouTube, podcasts, or even on _Fox News_ because of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—like our free online courses. __ And though we’re best known for educating Americans about the Constitution and founding principles through these free courses, one of our most popular courses has been about a famous _British_ author—C.S. Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **“[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqr2po4c0a7dm5c6c0vu96ttvdpp7qb3v77fvjmg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cdi68o32c9h2bs)” **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. body:
In the wake of President Trump’s big SCOTUS victory, we can’t let our guard down

Friend,

Donald Trump's victory in the presidential immunity case was a victory for the rule of law.

The **[very last thing](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyMkcuO2yAUhp8G74jg4ODxwotRrWyqdKLpoktE4NiDxmDEJaP26SuSZt8t_9F_-fh1VmftNhfWH9rj9GmSSlmFlI0yqf6hAdHSstMrKmDQUzZQzhR0drKjkVp2OPEBmGTARt59TJqLceFWj4MAvL4MvdELk8tRLiO3_Iidm5oPGzhjQy85O_Q9st4CvBixHBEY6ZneMJXDJ2I0e1gT5pww1uvmjA4Hs_tumz5KiZmIVwInAqeMpiY8fLmQ0LYLAqe2gcApaoq0pOojdd7X4MpvWppAxKkWrzxaVz0RM3rtNgKyPea9JoNEzDv4B4yo_0lG-6jdGoiYH0PYqIJW94RnwM2ZsqeWQ29cXV5VaSzVo9HdpRgi5u_f3ukTxtN9DwVDIWJearBJu-zCSkDmdv8G58v7288LAZna4NQ0MZdUkYDUvsQ9u-L21q3v0mTjl9s2l-VAera2eXd45f9_-TbB3wAAAP__26Czaw)** we need is for presidents to be subjected to harassment suits and political prosecutions for their official acts. subject: Introducing Our New Podcast
body:
We've just added a new podcast dedicated to bringing you insightful conversations about the pressing issues facing Washington state. This podcast is for those of us who are deeply concerned about what's happening right in our own backyard--from rising crime rates to the constant addition of new tax hikes. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63373556:sJOj9CWJN:m:1:2610672541:603D73AC4C8073EFAB529661FC4845CC:r "Shift Washington")
---
| Friends,

We are excited to announce a fantastic new addition to Shift WA's content lineup!
We've just added a new podcast dedicated to bringing you insightful conversations about the pressing issues facing Washington state. This podcast is for those of us who are deeply concerned about what's happening right in our own backyard--from rising crime rates to the constant addition of new tax hikes. The podcast is hosted by life-long Washington state residents and includes interviews with conservative thinkers and leaders sharing their perspectives and solutions for our state's challenges. **[Listen to the inaugural, introductory podcast today](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63373557:sJOj9CWJN:m:1:2610672541:603D73AC4C8073EFAB529661FC4845CC:r)** **- and don't forget to [subscribe](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63373558:sJOj9CWJN:m:1:2610672541:603D73AC4C8073EFAB529661FC4845CC:r)!
** Past episodes (also available) included guests like:

* The Washington Policy Center's Todd Myers on environmental policies and the Freedom Conservatism movement.
* Stand With Us Northwest's Randy Kessler on antisemitism in the Northwest.
* The National Review's Charles C.W. Cooke on the need for federalism and why Washington is no exception.
* The American Enterprise Institute's Rick Hess on the conservative vision for improving education.
* The Cato Institute's Colin Grabow on the Jones Act.

[**Take just one moment to subscribe now and stay up-to-date with our latest episodes.**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63373558:sJOj9CWJN:m:1:2610672541:603D73AC4C8073EFAB529661FC4845CC:r)

Thank you for being a part of the Shift WA community. We can't wait for you to join us on this new podcasting journey!

\- The Shift WA Team

P.S. Help us spread the word with friends and family who might also be interested in our new podcast by [sharing the news today](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63373559:sJOj9CWJN:m:1:2610672541:603D73AC4C8073EFAB529661FC4845CC:r)! | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/63373560:sJOj9CWJN:m:1:2610672541:603D73AC4C8073EFAB529661FC4845CC:r)

body:

Greetings!
This has been one of the busiest weeks of my life -- but in the best way.
This week, I'm in Milwaukee at the Republican National Convention with a few members of the APP team. We've been working hand-in-hand with the RNC platform committee to ensure the party adopts the strongest pro-family platform in history.
---
[](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010VypfM9neJbsVdOd-J4wGmTlWrSe-pp3GbpYfYPUFWgKgBZMNZetKbCeyfAdThIiEOci4iKMVpnhmFnJUOBJuyb_K0zGqjfhzLO69ocmx2kjjAUCS7y6BrnlT8tuJHgGl9zVNCGfeXywGhvRX3c7TUV1tQ_1TIw0bzvWe45IU2wH8K2nRiATaRVq3hXd_1F0NRqAfcCqODQ=&c=ANA1qEX0K1Lu6J-TEOjXEaHYPjs8jONhNJqujges84MHBYjlKuRLyw==&ch=DNN5W7ciEbQ1Lu9YDUKuAq25LuWWoSKgQnW1U1aAu8DvGBPywiJ57A==)
---
When the APP team sat down late last year to discuss our goals for 2024, one of our top priorities was ensuring that protections for American families were at the forefront of the RNC's platform and the 2024 election -- and we've now accomplished that!
I'm pleased to share that we were successful in securing several key pro-family planks as part of the party's platform this week. The 20-point platform released Monday has several policies that APP has fought for over the last few years, and our team is thrilled to see them officially adopted:
16\. Cut federal funding for any school pushing Critical Race Theory, radical gender ideology, and other inappropriate racial, sexual, or political content on our children.
As you know, APP has worked extensively with state and federal lawmakers to protect our children from harmful indoctrination. There has been an intentional effort to teach children, often through the public school system, that they should hate their country and hate themselves. This push has included CRT, LGBTQ propaganda, and the allowance of pornographic materials in public school libraries.
17\. Keep men out of women's sports.
During the 2019 gubernatorial race in Kentucky, APP PAC became the first political group ever to run ads attacking a candidate for supporting legislation that would allow men to compete in women's sports. Then, we began working with Kentucky All-American swimmer Riley Gaines to inject this issue into federal races across the country.
We've also worked extensively with state legislators and governors to pass legislation protecting women's sports in 24 states as well as working with Congressman Greg Steube (R-FL) to introduce and pass the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act in the U.S. House of Representatives.
This is a MASSIVE step in the right direction for protecting children and American families. The RNC platform committee has officially passed a platform with multiple pro-family planks, and we couldn't have done it without your support!
More to come soon.
Terry Schilling President American Principles Project

# [Warren G. Harding’s dog sat in on Cabinet meetings. ](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgemlx&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgemlx&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgemlx&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| I t isn’t uncommon to see pets in Zoom meetings these days, as some cats and dogs can’t help being the center of attention while their humans attempt to check in with their co-workers. Even so, the fact that Warren G. Harding’s dog sat in on Cabinet meetings sounds especially distracting (albeit in an adorable way) for such important positions as, say, the secretary of state. Laddie Boy, who’s been called the White House’s first celebrity dog, was an Airedale terrier whom the 29th president of the United States deeply adored. In addition to fetching the newspaper and joining the First Lady at fundraisers, he had his own seat at Cabinet meetings and was written about in the press on a near-daily basis.
---
Sometimes, Laddie Boy even “wrote” back. “So many people express a wish to see me, and I shake hands with so many callers at the Executive Mansion,” [read one such letter](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sgemlx&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), “that I fear there are some people who will suspect me of political inclinations. From what I see of politics, I am sure I have no such aspirations.” The presidential pup remained popular even as Harding did not (he’s routinely ranked among the worst heads of state in American history). Following Harding’s untimely death in 1923, a poem by Edna Bell Seward titled “Laddie Boy, He’s Gone” was set to music by composer George M. Seward in order to console the faithful dog.

## Presidents have had bobcats, tigers, and other exotic pets at the White House.
Having your pet in Cabinet meetings is a bold choice, but at least the animal itself was tame. The same can’t be said of all White House pets through history. There was Calvin Coolidge’s bobcat, Andrew Jackson’s foul-mouthed parrot Poll (who had to be removed from Jackson’s own funeral because it kept swearing), the sheep Woodrow Wilson kept on the White House lawn during World War I, and John F. Kennedy’s pony, Macaroni. When it comes to sheer quantity, however, no one tops Theodore Roosevelt. The 26th President had nearly 40 pets, including 11 horses, a badger, flying squirrels, five guinea pigs, six dogs, a hyena, and a bear, among others.

clean_body: It isn’t uncommon to see pets in Zoom meetings these days, as some cats and dogs can’t help being the center of attention while their humans attempt to check in with their co-workers. | I t isn’t uncommon to see pets in Zoom meetings these days, as some cats and dogs can’t help being the center of attention while their humans attempt to check in with their co-workers. Even so, the fact that Warren G. Harding’s dog sat in on Cabinet meetings sounds especially distracting (albeit in an adorable way) for such important positions as, say, the secretary of state. Laddie Boy, who’s been called the White House’s first celebrity dog, was an Airedale terrier whom the 29th president of the United States deeply adored. In addition to fetching the newspaper and joining the First Lady at fundraisers, he had his own seat at Cabinet meetings and was written about in the press on a near-daily basis. Sometimes, Laddie Boy even “wrote” back. “So many people express a wish to see me, and I shake hands with so many callers at the Executive Mansion,” , “that I fear there are some people who will suspect me of political inclinations. From what I see of politics, I am sure I have no such aspirations.” The presidential pup remained popular even as Harding did not (he’s routinely ranked among the worst heads of state in American history). Following Harding’s untimely death in 1923, a poem by Edna Bell Seward titled “Laddie Boy, He’s Gone” was set to music by composer George M. Seward in order to console the faithful dog. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Presidents without pets (Martin Van Buren, James K. Polk, Donald Trump) 3 | | Harding’s place in a 2021 ranking of Presidents 37 | Harding’s place in a 2021 ranking of Presidents 37 | | Presidents who have had dogs 31 | | Electoral votes won by Harding in the 1920 election 404 | Electoral votes won by Harding in the 1920 election 404 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Presidents have had bobcats, tigers, and other exotic pets at the White House. Having your pet in Cabinet meetings is a bold choice, but at least the animal itself was tame. The same can’t be said of all White House pets through history. There was Calvin Coolidge’s bobcat, Andrew Jackson’s foul-mouthed parrot Poll (who had to be removed from Jackson’s own funeral because it kept swearing), the sheep Woodrow Wilson kept on the White House lawn during World War I, and John F. Kennedy’s pony, Macaroni. When it comes to sheer quantity, however, no one tops Theodore Roosevelt. The 26th President had nearly 40 pets, including 11 horses, a badger, flying squirrels, five guinea pigs, six dogs, a hyena, and a bear, among others. body:

Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgdchccpupe3125tq9k2mfp8eslfd3i2amq4mka0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cdh6aob4cjh2bs)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvnl46qvcv5567080uhb48nij6cprdm946qpbudg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0cdh6aob4cjh2bs)**

Wishing you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

Hoover Institution | Stanford University

Friends,
House Republicans passed the Refrigerator Freedom Act and the Stop Unaffordable Dishwasher Standards (SUDS) Act, blocking energy efficiency standards for refrigerators, freezers, and dishwashers.
Rep. Katie Porter (D-CA) mocked the measures, highlighting the minimal monthly cost of running a dishwasher — just two to four dollars.
I agree with Rep. Porter; this legislation is a waste of time. "This is Congress at its worst. A bunch of people who haven’t unloaded a dishwasher ever telling Americans what dishwashers they should or shouldn’t have."
Congress has more important things to do.
Proper loading is the key to clean dishes, not deregulation. The simple solution stands in stark contrast to the complexity of this stupid legislation.
My opponent, Rep. Jack Bergman voted for this bill, choosing to focus on trivial issues amidst more pressing concerns.
As your next Congressperson, I would not engage in such triviality. We must prioritize meaningful legislation that addresses the real challenges facing Americans.
It’s time for meaningful change. It's time to clean House.
Onward,
Bob

"This is Congress at its worst. A bunch of people who haven’t unloaded a dishwasher ever telling Americans what dishwashers they should or shouldn’t have." Congress has more important things to do. Proper loading is the key to clean dishes, not deregulation. The simple solution stands in stark contrast to the complexity of this stupid legislation. My opponent, Rep. Jack Bergman voted for this bill, choosing to focus on trivial issues amidst more pressing concerns. As your next Congressperson, I would not engage in such triviality. We must prioritize meaningful legislation that addresses the real challenges facing Americans. It’s time for meaningful change. It's time to clean House. Onward, Bob Bob Lorinser Candidate for US Congress Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula Democrat, MI01 CONTRIBUTE [] [] Or, send a check to Friends of Dr. Bob PO BOX 936 Marquette, MI 49855 United States Paid for by Friends of Dr. Bob

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/10/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey everyone!
Heads up! The rumor mill is buzzing that former President Trump is on the verge of announcing his VP pick. Who will it be? Stay tuned for updates and in the meantime check out our [interview](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with Ben Carson (a name frequenting the rumors) on Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl from a few months back!
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, July 10, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Denver mayor wants a tax increase. Proposes lifting sales tax to 9.31%](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [KDVR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Denver Mayor Mike Johnston unveiled a proposal Monday to raise $100 million a year for affordable housing projects by raising the sales tax in Denver by 0.5%.
The proposed 0.5% tax will account for about 5 cents on a $10 purchase, according to a release sent by the mayor's office.
There would be exceptions for many of the everyday essentials people buy including food, fuel, medical supplies and personal hygiene products, meaning the new tax would not apply to those purchases.
Because it involves raising taxes, the proposal will need to be approved by the City Council and then by voters in November before being implemented.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In shadow of bipartisan Senate Bill 23-275 creating mustang task force, BLM plans another roundup](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Despite a collaborative state-federal effort to find humane alternatives for wild horse population control, the BLM plans a helicopter roundup of 85-110 mustangs in Colorado's Little Book Cliffs, sparking state criticism.
* Colorado Governor Jared Polis criticized the plan as excessive, advocating for more humane "bait and trap" methods over helicopter roundups to ensure better welfare for the horses.
* The situation underscores ongoing tension between state-led innovative management strategies, like fertility control, and the BLM's traditional, more invasive approaches, highlighting differing views on effective wild horse management

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[U.S. to expand control of land sales to foreigners near military sites](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [AIR FORCE TIMES ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The U.S. Treasury plans to expand the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States' (CFIUS) authority to review land sales near military sites to include 56 additional locations, raising the total to 227 sites.
* The expansion, influenced by a 2018 law, aims to enhance national security by scrutinizing real estate transactions near key military sites like Naval Air Station Corpus Christi and Cannon Air Force Base.
* This regulatory move follows recent national security concerns, including a presidential order in May that prevented a Chinese-backed firm from owning land near a Wyoming nuclear missile base, reflecting a broader strategy to safeguard sensitive U.S. locations from foreign influence

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**['Washington' Republicans have failed America, Heritage Foundation president says ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Heritage Foundation President Kevin Roberts criticized "Beltway Republicans" at the National Conservatism Conference for their compromises and failure to prioritize American interests, leading to national decline.
* Roberts denounced libertarians and neoconservatives within the GOP for promoting policies he views as detrimental to America's domestic and international standing.
* He called for a unified conservative movement focused on national conservatism to counter progressive extremism and restore the republic.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Dion: Colorado Republicans, it's time to unite and fight ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
_In Colorado, Republican Party politics has been defined in recent years by losses, infighting and a steady decline in the percentage of Colorado voters that affiliate with the party._
_Consider, just 24% of Colorado 's registered voters were republicans as of June 2024. Democrats have controlled all statewide offices, and both chambers of Colorado's state legislature since 2019._
_In short, it 's been tough to be a Colorado Republican of late. _
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Kirk: To secure the White House in 2024, we must win low-propensity voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY CALLER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
_As the media world and D.C. insiders become increasingly transfixed by the fallout from President Joe Biden 's disastrous debate performance, it becomes more important than ever that the conservative movement remains steadfastly focused on the most important things -- namely, registering voters and chasing their ballots._ ___This is the hard work that wins elections in our modern era and that has quite literally flipped conventional election logic on its head._
_To that end, there is a term you are going to hear more and more this summer and fall as the key factor in former President Donald Trump 's hopes of retaking the White House: "Low-propensity voter."_
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Tooker: Why am I opposed to the 400,000-acre proposed Dolores River National Monument?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY AIMEE TOOKER | COMMENTARY | JULY 9** _The west end of Montrose County is one of four Tier One coal-affected communities in Colorado. The effect of the closure of Western Fuels coal mine in 2018 and Tri-State Generation and Transmission 's coal plant in 2019 (two years ahead of schedule) had an obvious detrimental effect on our local businesses._
**_[Wood: Gov. Polis' 'Roadmap 2.0' is not economically sustainable, equitable, environmentally balanced or fact-based](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY PETE WOOD | COMMENTARY | JULY 5** _This past February, Gov. Jared Polis introduced his "Roadmap 2.0" that aims to cut greenhouse gas emissions in half by 2030 and achieve net-zero emissions in Colorado by 2050._
**[Boebert announces mobile office hours, locations in July](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 5** _Residents in the 3rd District will have seven opportunities in July to take advantage of mobile office hours being offered by U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert._

Foods with names reflecting German origins, such as hamburgers and frankfurters, were rebranded to **"liberty steak"** and **"liberty sausage"** respectively.

Friend --
Next week, Republicans will kick-off their national convention, ending with the official nomination of Donald Trump as their presidential candidate.
I want to talk a little bit about the convention, and what it means for our race here in Michigan.
First, this is four nights of national media coverage for National Republicans which can show if they are capable of remaining disciplined in their messaging. That is a lot of eyeballs, and potentially undecided voters, watching.
Second, because there is no state as important as Michigan in this election, you can be sure a lot of their messaging will be geared toward reaching voters in our state, including even potentially a speaking slot for at least one of our potential opponents.
Third, these conventions tend to drive a lot of donations and activism to Republican candidates up-and-down the ballot. And that is an advantage we don't have at this moment.
So this is one of those weeks where the response from those who want to see me -- and all Democrats -- win in Michigan is important. So if you're looking for a good time to donate, this is as good as it gets.

name: Gavin Newsom
subject: I want to try something pretty ambitious this week
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
We’re setting a goal of contacting 22 million people we believe are good, solid Democratic voters in every state across the country.

Folks,
The formula for winning is simple.
There are more Democrats than Republicans in this country. We just need to make sure they vote. If we do, we win. From President Biden to Congress, to our statehouses.
So I want to try something pretty ambitious this week, but I need your help to get it done.
As you've seen in a few previous emails, we're building a volunteer operation that can reach out and talk to voters in states across the country to do what I described above.
That effort starts in earnest tomorrow with a goal of contacting 22 million people we believe are good, solid Democratic voters in every state across the country.
We'll do it largely via text message conversations. There are already 1,000 people signed up to help. But talking to 22 million people... we need more.
So... I'm asking you to join this community. I'm asking you to do something that will help Democrats WIN this November. What do you say?
[**Use this link to say you're interested in joining our texting team, and to get started with our online community of others like you committed to make sure Democrats win this fall. We'll be in touch with more.**](https://campaignfordemocracy.com/text/?source=em240709-1)
[JOIN THE TEAM](https://campaignfordemocracy.com/text/?source=em240709-1)
Some of you have experience doing this. That's great. For others, it will be your first time. Also great.
But if you look at how many close races there were in the last election, and the tight polls in this one, these critical conversations can mean the difference between winning and losing.
We're talking about the fate and future of our democracy, this country and the world. They all need us right now.
[**So please - take the first, small step: Use this link to sign-up and say you're interested in joining our texting team.**](https://campaignfordemocracy.com/text/?source=em240709-1)
[JOIN THE TEAM](https://campaignfordemocracy.com/text/?source=em240709-1)
22 million conversations. It'd be amazing. That's a lot of voters that will help tip key states and races.
Can't do it without you.
\- Gavin

clean_body: We’re setting a goal of contacting 22 million people we believe are good, solid Democratic voters in every state across the country. Folks, The formula for winning is simple. There are more Democrats than Republicans in this country. We just need to make sure they vote. If we do, we win. From President Biden to Congress, to our statehouses. So I want to try something pretty ambitious this week, but I need your help to get it done. As you've seen in a few previous emails, we're building a volunteer operation that can reach out and talk to voters in states across the country to do what I described above. That effort starts in earnest tomorrow with a goal of contacting 22 million people we believe are good, solid Democratic voters in every state across the country. We'll do it largely via text message conversations. There are already 1,000 people signed up to help. But talking to 22 million people... we need more. So... I'm asking you to join this community. I'm asking you to do something that will help Democrats WIN this November. What do you say? Some of you have experience doing this. That's great. For others, it will be your first time. Also great. But if you look at how many close races there were in the last election, and the tight polls in this one, these critical conversations can mean the difference between winning and losing. We're talking about the fate and future of our democracy, this country and the world. They all need us right now. 22 million conversations. It'd be amazing. That's a lot of voters that will help tip key states and races. Can't do it without you. \- Gavin

| | | | | Peter, It’s Alexander Vindman, reaching out to you with a personal request. [Can you split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and my twin brother Eugene’s campaign for Congress today? I ask because I know I can count on you. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcf3272b1-16ed-4a9d-beb7-7548b042cedc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) You probably know this already, but Eugene and I value integrity and honesty above all else. These principles guided us throughout our decades of military service. It's what compelled us to blow the whistle on Donald Trump's attempt to extort our allies in Ukraine when we overheard a concerning phone call. And now, it's what motivated Eugene to run for Congress. Eugene is running for Congress to uphold those same values and continue his fight to defend our democracy and the Constitution we both vowed to protect. And more than that, he will fight to restore and expand the fundamental rights right-wing forces have worked so hard to take away: the right to reproductive freedom, the right to vote, the right for us and our kids to live without fear of gun violence. But he can't win these fights alone. I am with him – nothing is more important to me right now. But we need you with us, standing by our side, because Trump and his allies will do whatever they can to keep him out of Washington. [So, Peter, can I count on you to split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and my brother Eugene Vindman's campaign for Congress in Virginia? ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T09d8dff4-9d61-4db8-b0d1-3558668a6f5b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

July 10, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Mary Peltola is Absent While Joe Biden and the Democrats Hurt Alaskans

ANCHORAGE, AK - This week, Mary Peltola announced to Alaska that she
wouldn't be showing up for work, leaving our state with no voice in the
U.S. House. She has been silent on Joe Biden's public decline after his
debate disaster and now she is skipping critical votes including one on
the SAVE Act that will secure our elections and ensure only citizens
can vote. Put simply: she is not doing her job.

After 13 days, Mary Peltola's only comment is that her opinion on Joe
Biden's public decline is "irrelevant."
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69969&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=62715> It's a slap in the face to her
constituents as the Biden administration shuts down our state
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69969&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=62716> .

"Peltola is avoiding work and missing critical votes, and her void of
leadership is hurting Alaska," Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom said in a
statement. "It is sad to see Alaska's sole congressional representative
absent during such a critical week in Washington. She is missing votes
to secure our elections and she is putting her party politics ahead of
her constituents' needs. Alaska needs real leadership, not this."

###

The most recent polling in Arizona shows Ruben Gallego and Kari Lake neck-and-neck — and a leaked NRSC poll has Kari leading Ruben by one point.
#

Peter -
$10.
That’s the donation we’re asking you to make to Ruben Gallego’s campaign before the RNC kicks off in a few days.
Back in 2020, Mark Kelly took Arizona’s seat back from the GOP. In 2022, we defended that seat. It took hundreds of thousands of people chipping in to do it, and many of you probably played a role in those victories.
But this is a different race and a different time. If we lose in Arizona it isn’t just a Senate seat that’s at risk. It’s the White House, too. It’s our entire democracy.
Trump knows how important this state is. That’s why he’s helping Kari Lake raise money at Mar-a-Lago, why he told all of his supporters to rally around her campaign, and why Arizona was the first place he came after he was found guilty of 34 felonies.
Right now, he’s leading in Arizona. Kari Lake isn’t far behind. And in both of their last campaigns here, they each lost by less than 1% of all votes cast when all was said and done. Razor thin margins with no room for error. It’s neck-and-neck, and we’ve got to win.
It’s going to take an absolutely massive effort to win in Arizona in 2024 — bigger than 2020 and 2022. Ruben’s staring down millions of dollars in attack ads, and it’s only going to get worse from here. So, we’re asking:

body:
Here’s the truth
---
Derek -- In just a moment, we are going to ask you to donate directly to the Democratic National Committee before the Republican convention begins and our FEC deadline ends. Please give us a chance to explain why this request is so important. Here is the truth: Most years, the FEC fundraising deadlines we write about happen once every three months. Those are the big, official deadlines. And when they end, we are legally required to report what we've raised for everyone to see. But during the homestretch of presidential campaign years, these official FEC deadlines happen every month -- which means we have another one coming up fast. And this one is especially important. It will be the first full report we file after the presidential debate, Trump's VP announcement, and the Republican convention. Everyone in the press will be watching what we file and what Republicans file -- and the difference will be talked about by the press for days. So we're hoping for a big report. And at the same time, we also need to reach our very real fundraising goals for the month. And we need you for both. subject: BREAKING: Trump Campaign Not Getting Involved in IL GOP Chair Race
body:
Senior officials in the RNC and Trump campaign confirm they will not be weighing into the race to replace IL GOP Chair Don Tracy.

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to read this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT:
Trump Campaign Not Getting Involved in IL GOP Chairman's Race, Proving Rumors False, Sources Confirm (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/trump-campaign-not-getting-involved-in-il-gop-chairmans-race-proving-rumors-false-sources-confirm.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f6fe0ed138-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/trump-campaign-not-getting-involved-in-il-gop-chairmans-race-proving-rumors-false-sources-confirm.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f6fe0ed138-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Former President Trump points to supporters during a campaign rally at the Atkinson Country Club on Jan. 16, 2024, in Atkinson, New Hampshire. (Brandon Bell/Getty Images)

By Illinois Review
The race to replace Don Tracy as chairman of the Illinois Republican Party is heating up just days before the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, as several potential candidates are making their case to Illinois Republicans on who’s the best fit to lead the embattled state party through the November election and beyond.

And multiple sources confirm with this publication that senior officials within the Trump campaign and the RNC have made it clear Wednesday morning that they will not be weighing in on the state party chairman’s race as rumors began circulating across the state the last few days that “campaign officials” were backing a candidate to replace Tracy. The chatter also included rumors that even President Donald Trump would be weighing in and endorsing a candidate – but those rumors have proven to be false.

The Trump campaign and the RNC have been busy preparing for the convention in Milwaukee next week and finalizing the vice presidential candidate selection process as the world awaits President Trump’s pick to complete his ticket. Illinois is also not a state in play for Trump as he focuses his time and energy on key battleground states in the final months of the campaign.

Last month, Don Tracy submitted his
resignation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f6fe0ed138-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) as party chairman effective July 19th – blaming the rise of the “grassroots,” party infighting and the removal of state central committee member Mark Shaw as vice chairman of the party without “due process” as the embattled leader of the IL GOP presided over widespread and massive losses during his brief tenure as chairman. Tracy also blamed the rise of the “grassroots,” writing, “Like Vince Kolber, my friend and former Finance Committee Chair, I am also concerned about the current infatuation of some members of the SCC, few as they are, with certain individuals they call ‘Grass roots’ leaders.” The outgoing state party chairman has yet to endorse President Trump and has spent the last year attending Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis events, and hosting the governor at an IL GOP fundraiser i
n Naples.

Days before Tracy’s unexpected resignation, Kolber, who served as chairman of the IL GOP Finance Committee, abruptly
resigned (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/breaking-vince-kolber-who-votes-in-il-wi-resigns-as-il-gop-finance-chairman-blames-grassroots-for-his-downfall.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f6fe0ed138-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in an angry letter to Tracy, just weeks after the influential conservative grassroots base of the Illinois Republican Party scored major victories during the GOP State Convention in Collinsville – and after two years of unflattering stories by this publication. Kolber, who is registered to vote in Illinois and Wisconsin, was still angry about losing his election at the state convention for national committeeman after being eliminated in the first round to Mark Shaw, who faked a delegate badge and threatened to beat up a fellow state central committee member. During the first day of the convention, the Republican National Committeeman nominating committee voted 14-3 to keep Kolber on the ballot despite failing to meet the candidacy requirements as outlined by the IL GOP’s own bylaws.

clean_body: Senior officials in the RNC and Trump campaign confirm they will not be weighing into the race to replace IL GOP Chair Don Tracy. view in browser () | update preferences () | unsubscribe () This IR e-Blast Powered By: Dear Peter, We thought you may be interested to read this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT: Trump Campaign Not Getting Involved in IL GOP Chairman's Race, Proving Rumors False, Sources Confirm () Former President Trump points to supporters during a campaign rally at the Atkinson Country Club on Jan. 16, 2024, in Atkinson, New Hampshire. (Brandon Bell/Getty Images) By Illinois Review The race to replace Don Tracy as chairman of the Illinois Republican Party is heating up just days before the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, as several potential candidates are making their case to Illinois Republicans on who’s the best fit to lead the embattled state party through the November election and beyond. And multiple sources confirm with this publication that senior officials within the Trump campaign and the RNC have made it clear Wednesday morning that they will not be weighing in on the state party chairman’s race as rumors began circulating across the state the last few days that “campaign officials” were backing a candidate to replace Tracy. The chatter also included rumors that even President Donald Trump would be weighing in and endorsing a candidate – but those rumors have proven to be false. The Trump campaign and the RNC have been busy preparing for the convention in Milwaukee next week and finalizing the vice presidential candidate selection process as the world awaits President Trump’s pick to complete his ticket. Illinois is also not a state in play for Trump as he focuses his time and energy on key battleground states in the final months of the campaign. Last month, Don Tracy submitted his resignation () as party chairman effective July 19th – blaming the rise of the “grassroots,” party infighting and the removal of state central committee member Mark Shaw as vice chairman of the party without “due process” as the embattled leader of the IL GOP presided over widespread and massive losses during his brief tenure as chairman. Tracy also blamed the rise of the “grassroots,” writing, “Like Vince Kolber, my friend and former Finance Committee Chair, I am also concerned about the current infatuation of some members of the SCC, few as they are, with certain individuals they call ‘Grass roots’ leaders.” The outgoing state party chairman has yet to endorse President Trump and has spent the last year attending Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis events, and hosting the governor at an IL GOP fundraiser i n Naples. Days before Tracy’s unexpected resignation, Kolber, who served as chairman of the IL GOP Finance Committee, abruptly resigned () in an angry letter to Tracy, just weeks after the influential conservative grassroots base of the Illinois Republican Party scored major victories during the GOP State Convention in Collinsville – and after two years of unflattering stories by this publication. Kolber, who is registered to vote in Illinois and Wisconsin, was still angry about losing his election at the state convention for national committeeman after being eliminated in the first round to Mark Shaw, who faked a delegate badge and threatened to beat up a fellow state central committee member. During the first day of the convention, the Republican National Committeeman nominating committee voted 14-3 to keep Kolber on the ballot despite failing to meet the candidacy requirements as outlined by the IL GOP’s own bylaws. Applicants for state party chairman must submit their completed application () to the state party headquarters by email no later than 5:00 pm CDT today. Our global ministry, Light a Candle, brings the Light into dark places. In addition to preaching the Gospel, we strive to be the hands and feet of Jesus by meeting the physical needs of hurting people. Later this year, we're holding a HUGE revival IN THE NATION OF INDIA, but before it happens, God told us to buy land and build a distribution center to meet the needs of hurting people, and we obeyed! We purchased the land, and now it's time to build!!

We are about to break ground at a site in India, but **we need to raise $300,000 to construct this three-story resource distribution center**. Peter,
As Fire Captain with the Orange County Fire Authority for 34 years, Joe lives and breathes public service – literally. He's spent his life putting the needs of our community ahead of his own.
When crisis struck Orange County during its 1994 bankruptcy, Joe saved countless jobs and livelihoods by creating the first Orange County firefighter union. He served as their President for 17 years, and while there, he balanced OCFA’s budgets, created a healthcare system for his firefighters, and increased their benefits.
As a labor leader, Joe helped get over 200 bills and initiatives passed and signed into law by five governors and two presidents. These bills and initiatives offered solutions to public safety, climate change, and policies to help working people.
Joe knows how hard it is for families to get ahead these days, and he knows what it takes to regrow the working class. As a decorated firefighter and labor leader, he has a record of delivering real results for working people. He will do the same for us in Washington. body:
We must unite as a party. We must focus our attention and our efforts on defeating Donald Trump. | | |
---
Peter -- I sent a letter to Democrats in Congress to make it clear: **_I am staying in this race, and we're going to win._** Look, I have heard the concerns that people have, the good-faith fears and worries about what is at stake in this election. I am not blind to them. Believe me, I know better than anyone the responsibility and the burden the nominee of our party carries. But let me say clearly and unequivocally: **I wouldn't be running if I did not absolutely believe that I can and I will beat Donald Trump in November.** Now we must unite as a party. We must focus our attention and our efforts on defeating Trump, on defending American democracy, and on protecting people's freedoms. [**But I can't do it without you, Peter. Believe me, I know better than anyone the responsibility and the burden the nominee of our party carries. But let me say clearly and unequivocally: I wouldn't be running if I did not absolutely believe that I can and I will beat Donald Trump in November. Now we must unite as a party. We must focus our attention and our efforts on defeating Trump, on defending American democracy, and on protecting people's freedoms. | | | I feel a deep obligation to trust the voters of the Democratic Party. Millions of you cast a ballot for me and Kamala in primaries across the country. That's the process. It was a decision for voters to make -- not the press, the pundits, the big donors, or any powerful interest group. Look at what happened when we stood together in 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023. We won. Because the fact of the matter is we have a historic record of success to run on. We are the ones creating millions of jobs. The ones lowering costs for families, protecting Social Security and Medicare, combating climate change, and providing student debt relief. There are 40 days until the Democratic National Convention. Any weakening of resolve or lack of clarity only helps Trump. | | Folks, I've been energized by the determination this team has shown over recent weeks. You know me. You know I’m a freedom fighter, a defender of liberty, and an advocate for a smaller, more effective federal government. If Republicans do not do everything in our power to help Tim Sheehy defeat Jon Tester in Montana, we will not be able to capture the Senate majority in November. That’s just a fact. While I’m grateful that conservatives like you open emails like this one, Not ready to donate yet? Transparency: As far as I’m aware, few Americans support elected officials beholden to lobbyists and special interest groups. Tim’s opponent is the largest recipient of lobbyist dollars in the United States Senate. 3. Service: As a former Navy SEAL and recipient of a Purple Heart and Bronze Star medal, Tim truly knows what it means to put his country first. Veterans make the best public servants; bravery and honor are not things someone can teach. Tim’s race in Montana will likely be one of, if not the most expensive, Senate races this year. When I tell you that If you want more of the same, then by all means, ignore me, this email, and my request for your assistance. | | | | **_Recent Election Outcomes_** **UK** One hopeful word is overwhelming the streets of the UK this week: **Change**. It marks a historic moment where we have witnessed the left-wing Labour Government dominate parliament for the first time since 1997. After _14 years of Conservative rule_ , a new wave of change and**hope spreads** as the people have voted AGAINST the Conservative Party, and recently elected Prime Minister Keir Starmer steps into office. As people have turned their trust away from the Conservative Party and its claims to use _Brexit_ as a method of success and independence for all, it has _backfired and caused deeper confusion_ and**distrust for Conservative leaders** , leading to their foreseeable defeat. With their heads turned to Prime Minister Keir Starmer, it is evident that this **landslide victory** has led to fertile ground for partnership within the UK and its friends in the European Union. The question of identity rose when the Conservative Party previously gained power in parliament. Now, more than ever, the people have a united voice and lifted spirit for the UK as they flood the streets in celebration of PM Keir Starmer, agreeing that Brexit has only further complicated and divided the nation. Therefore, it is time to stop delivering empty promises and **restore the trust** between the people's needs and wants and the parties' ability to fulfill them through tangible action. The newly elected Labour Government has begun to do just that. Notably, these turnouts have led to the election of the**first-ever female Treasury Chief,** Rachel Reeves. She aims to bring stability and economic growth in a time of immense financial insecurity, further provoked by the Conservative Party's deep infiltration of unsustainable economic policies and business-geared perspectives rather than pursuing beneficial policies for the common person, the majority. Together, the Labour Party has set out focus points for change: immigration reform to eliminate the wasteful use of taxpayer dollars on unsuccessful and costly deportations, and proactively resetting relationships with the UK’s neighbors to find common ground for partnership, to name a few.
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2u2j0n-e2rxb3-kyd76rh0/)
---
**France** An uprising of anti-far-right protests and cheering crowds has increased in France as the time nears for electing a left-wing prime minister. Once divisive perspectives of leftists and centrists are diminishing as they form a left-wing alliance called the New Popular Front to counteract the support of Marine Le Pen’s far-right party, their xenophobic and anti-semtic views. President Emmanuel Macron will have to name a Prime Minister from among the leftists because they won the most seats. This is good news for leftists, whose views and initiatives will take up more space in parliament. Despite claims of uncertainty, a core fact remains: there is a harmonious stance against the far-right coming from the people, which will consequently lead to a left-leaning Prime Minister. Yesterday, many gathered in Paris, exchanging hugs, expressing tears of joy, and with filled spirits. Despite President Macron’s weak attempts to abuse his presidential power and call an unexpected snap legislative election, voters rejected the far-right, confirmed through the polls' left-leaning outcomes, leaving the far-right front-runners in third place. What this breakthrough means for the left is that it will complicate President Macron’s initiatives in the remainder of his presidency and will amplify the previously belittled voices of left-leaning voters and parties alike.

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

Our families thought that we had a lot in common, as well as a deep care for service. I want to dedicate this email to my husband. Watching Wes work day in and day out to fight for the rights of Marylanders is what inspires me. His drive , his passion — it adds up to make for a true role model, and someone I am proud to call my husband. Wes works beyond the boundaries of partisan politics, fighting to ensure that all Marylanders have an equal opportunity to thrive in this state. He has accomplished so much in his time as Governor. **It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

clean_body: Setting the record straight in Arizona | = Peter, we're setting the record straight on the judicial disaster unfolding in Arizona: Arizona Republicans are scheming to take power away from voters to protect anti-choice state Supreme Court justices. Here's what's going on: In Arizona, Supreme Court justices are elected by voters, and each justice serves for six years before being up for reelection. This year, two Arizona state Supreme Court justices will be on the ballot — both of whom voted in favor of Arizona's Civil War-era abortion ban. = | = Arizona Republicans know these justices do not represent the will of most Arizonans, and that their disastrous rulings on the abortion ban will cost them dearly at the ballot box. So what is the Republican-majority state Legislature proposing? A ballot measure that would remove voters' right to retain or dismiss Supreme and Superior Court justices — instead allowing justices to serve lifetime appointments. (In other words, they want the Arizona Supreme Court to work the same way as the U.S. Supreme Court, which as we know has been very effective at attacking abortion rights.) Here's the truth, Peter: This plan is fueled by the GOP's desire to retain the Arizona Supreme Court judges who voted to enforce the state's 1864 total abortion ban. If the Republican ballot measure were to pass, anti-choice justices could stay on the bench for life with no accountability and no way for voters to make their voices heard. This is just one more way anti-choice extremists are doing everything in their power to roll back reproductive rights across America. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

## Note from The Host Committee
---
| Welcome back to Host Committee Happenings. The Democratic National Convention is only **40** days away!
The Host Committee is proud to announce that over **12,000** prospective volunteers have completed the official volunteer application. Chicago, Illinois, and the Midwest are eager to show up for the city and play an important role in this historic event. Thank you to our Neighborhood Ambassadors for your dedicated recruitment efforts, and thank you to everyone who completed an application!

Influenced by his rich Indian and Pakistani heritage and driven by a passion for the culinary arts, Chef Faraz Sardharia opened the first Tandoor Char House in Chicago's **Lincoln Park** neighborhood in 2012, specializing in Indian-Pakistani fusion cuisine. Tandoor Char House also has two to-go locations in **River North** and **West Town**. Frequently described as a "gem" and "delicious" by customers, the restaurant has earned a loyal following. Tandoor Char House is family-focused, offers halal meats, and is BYOB to meet the cultural and community expectations it serves. You can find Tandoor Char House on the [DNC Vendor Directory](https://chicago2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2032775a03190d822e2a0e73&id=46f49f7183&e=e789b9d47e).
