## MAGA Exemplifies Didn't Earn It
Let me be clear right off the bat. MAGA claims that "DEI" stands for "Didn't Earn It" is truly remarkable because in reality, generating historic wealth through 2 billion acres of stolen land from Native Americans, enslaving Black people for 300 years, banning Asian immigration until 1965, and banning women from financial access til 1974 -- all without paying a single red cent in reparations or restitution -- is the living breathing example of not earning it.
Every MAGA accusation is a confession, and projection of their own weakness. Now, let's dive into the P25 attacks on DEI.
## P25 Mentions DEI At Least 15 Times
The phrase "Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion" is referenced at least 15 times in the P25 manifesto. The P25 Forward sets the tone for how degradingly it treats DEI, stating:
> The next conservative President must make the institutions of American civil society hard targets for woke culture warriors. This starts with deleting the terms sexual orientation and gender identity ("SOGI"), **diversity, equity, and inclusion ( "DEI")**, gender, gender equality, gender equity, gender awareness, gender-sensitive, abortion, reproductive health, reproductive rights, and any other term used to deprive Americans of their First Amendment rights out of every federal rule, agency regulation, contract, grant, regulation, and piece of legislation that exists.
You'll notice the truly remarkable irony of professing to stand up for First Amendment rights while championing a punitive government ban on certain words they don't like. P25 then continues by addressing DEI in the military, in higher education, and in federal agencies, and argues for the need to remove it from every aspect of government.
## DEI and the Military
On Page 103 the P25 fascists declare they intend to ban DEI in the military, writing:
> Eliminate Marxist indoctrination and divisive critical race theory programs and abolish newly established diversity, equity, and inclusion offices and staff.
Once again, P25 defines free speech as shutting down speech and representation they do not like. This isn't democracy, this is fascism. But it doesn't stop here. In a formal section on "The DEI Agenda" on Page 258, P25 calls for defunding of all DEI initiatives, and furthermore demands that all "_implementers and grantees that engage in ideological agitation on behalf of the DEI agenda should be dismissed, and entities should be debarred_."
In other words, fire anyone who so much as utters the words DEI. This type of backwards and oppressive thinking will stagnate our government and our military, and purge critical thinkers--in effect creating a brain drain. Rather than recruiting the best and brightest, this risks accelerating _kakistocracy_ , which is "_a government led by the least qualified, most stupid members._ " A truly fitting description for MAGA extremists.
## DEI and Higher Education
P25 then turns its ire to higher education, lamenting (incorrectly) on Page 352 that DEI violates federal civil rights laws in admissions processes. I can only imagine this is a nod to the MAGA intention to assert the fabricated presence of 'anti-white' discrimination in America. Predictably, P25 concludes that:
> The next Administration should work with Congress to amend the HEA and should consider the following reforms: l Prohibit accreditation agencies from leveraging their Title IV gatekeeper role to mandate that educational institutions adopt diversity, equity, and inclusion policies.
A few pages later P25 mandates a university funding strategy to prevent companies like "Ford and Google" from funding DEI initiatives at universities. So much for free market economics and small government, right?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..ROO3i85XxIP_Ox_zRtUPe5HGeqtRTOaaYCJw1Of5-pE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146457486)
## DEI and Federal Agencies
Continuing the facade, on Page 561, P25 makes the remarkable claim that:
> Federal agencies and their components have established so-called diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) offices that have become the vehicles for this unlawful discrimination, and all departments and agencies have created "equity" plans to carry out these invidious schemes.
This reminds me of the old saying, "_when you 've had privilege your whole life, equality feels like oppression_." The MAGA fascists behind P25 have enjoyed privilege their entire lives, and the mere idea that they are no longer the center of attention translates in their mind as "unlawful discrimination."
On Page 582, P25 calls for the elimination of "racial classifications" in labor, and of course blames DEI for such efforts at fair hiring to have existed in the first place. If you haven't already, [I address the MAGA myths on Affirmative Action here](https://substack.com/redirect/8da28cc7-2a39-4e5e-b730-bcbf37dc5f32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and this well rebukes the P25 propaganda around racial classifications in hiring.
On Page 708, P25 takes a hammer to DEI in the Treasury Department, demanding in significant part that the potentially future Trump administration should:
> ...expose and eradicate the practice of critical race theory and diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) throughout the Treasury Department. These steps will include: Identify...and ensure that such [DEI] initiatives are completely ended. Treat the participation in any critical race theory or DEI initiative ... as per se grounds for termination of employment. Eliminate the 25-member Treasury Advisory Committee on Racial Equity.
Again, it should concern anyone who believes in a system of checks and balances, that P25 is advocating for the wholesale termination and punishment of those uttering the words DEI. Where does this extremism and limitation on speech stop?
On Page 830, P25 makes a similar call to dismantle DEI initiatives in the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC"). And finally on Page 873, P25 asserts, without evidence, that DEI is being utilized as part of a scheme to win favor and government contracts while offering an inferior product or service or even to cover criminal activity, stating:
> ...there is a movement of firms attempting to use both ESG and DEI as a sort of reputational laundering to avoid enforcement of potentially criminal activity. The FTC should set up an ESG/DEI collusion task force to investigate firms--particularly in private equity--to see if they are using the practice as a means to meet targets, fix prices, or reduce output.
The irony of P25 complaining about criminal activity on financial matters when their dear leader was just convicted of 34 counts of financial fraud. I'm reminded of Frank Wilhoit's wisdom that, "_Conservatism consists of exactly one proposition. There must be in-groups whom the law protects but does not bind, alongside out-groups whom the law binds but does not protect_." P25 protects but does not bind MAGAs, and binds but does not protect anyone not MAGA.

## In Summary
P25 views DEI as the source of all ills in America. It is dead set on returning our government and business hiring practices to the Jim Crow era, a time when Black people, Asians, Latinos, and women had no meaningful opportunity for an equal shot at admission, a job, a loan, or a promotion. A P25 administration will absolutely further normalize discrimination against people of color and women, not to mention LGBTQ+ Americans. And P25 absolutely will fine, punish, and arguably imprison for alleged racial discrimination anyone who even mentions the concepts of DEI. It is imperative, therefore, that we do not allow this fascist manifesto to become American policy.

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Peter, **The empire is pulling out all the stops to try to derail our campaign.** After Biden’s disastrous debate, millions of voters saw that the emperor has no clothes, and started looking for a campaign that shares their vision of a just and livable future. Nothing scares the political elites more - so it’s no surprise that they’re trying to knock out the leading anti-war, pro-worker, climate action campaign that’s already on the ballot for the majority of voters across the country. **Here’s the empire’s latest assault on democracy:** On Thursday June 27th, the FEC informed us that our campaign had qualified for primary matching funds. Then minutes later, **FEC told us the Treasury department will withhold our payments** to give priority to general election funding - _just in case_ the Democratic and Republican candidates decide they want it. **Let me explain why that’s so outrageous:**
* In 2022, there was over $420 million available for public funding in the Presidential Election Campaign, thanks to taxpayers who check the box on their income tax forms to contribute $3 to the cause.

* On March 22, 2024, **Congress raided the Presidential Election Campaign Fund** for $375m. This was well after we posted that “qualifying for public matching funds will be a game-changer for our campaign.” According to the FEC, there is now about $17 million left in the fund.

* **Secretary of the Treasury Janet Yellen - a Biden appointee - is now using this manufactured shortfall to withhold matching funds for qualified primary election candidates** to “prioritize” hypothetical general election candidates.

* The only candidates who could claim general election funds under the rules are the Democrat - Biden - and the Republican - Trump. But claiming public funds would limit these billion-dollar campaigns to spending the $17m in available public funding, and foregoing all private donations.

* In other words: **there’s no way in Hell that Biden or Trump will use public funds, and everyone knows it, but the Biden administration is using that “possibility” to withhold the matching funds we qualified for -** until two weeks after the Democratic nominating convention, _long after we need the money for our ballot drives._

**It’s a huge tribute to our campaign that the Democrats are declaring all-out war on democracy to stop us,** with their army of lawyers to sue us off the ballot, their job postings for campaign infiltrators and spies, and now their assault on public funding. They are terrified that we're on a roll to challenge empire, oligarchy, and genocide in this election. [**So I’m asking you from the bottom of my heart to give whatever you can today to keep our campaign going full speed ahead.**](https://www.jillstein2024.com/matching?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=matching_funds_delayed_7_9&n=2) The empire is doubling down, so we need to do the same to stay in the fight. This is their last-ditch effort to stop us. **If we can get through this together, we’ll be unstoppable.**

Peter,
Two years ago, the U.S. Senate passed the CHIPS Act to end China’s domination of the semiconductor industry and keep more tech jobs in the U.S.
But there was a catch... the law contained language that requires companies to comply with ridiculous DEI regulations that have NOTHING to do with saving American jobs.
**That’s why Coach has introduced the CHIPS Improvement Act to remove this woke language from the CHIPS Act.**
This change will end costly “politically correct” H.R. practices, allowing American companies to better compete with Communist China.
_Make no mistake – this isn’t just about stopping jobs from going overseas. Allowing China to make the vast majority of our computer chips is a _major national security threat_._
Nearly every piece of technology we use today – cell phones, HVAC systems, cars, even appliances – relies on chips. And allowing China to control the chip supply chain gives them massive leverage over our country.
We must remove every possible obstacle for U.S. companies to compete with China, and that’s why passing this bill to improve the CHIPS Act is so crucial.
\- Team Tuberville

mainstream media coverage years into an unprecedented illegal
immigration crisis, untold numbers of “fighting age males” dressed
in military uniforms are entering the United States through remote
areas with no Border Patrol presence.

As the nation’s largest southern border crossings finally receive
mainstream media coverage years into an unprecedented illegal
immigration crisis, untold numbers of “fighting age males” dressed
in military uniforms are entering the United States through remote
areas with no Border Patrol presence. It is a palpable security lapse
unlikely to be reported by most news outlets and local, federal, and
state law enforcement sources have provided Judicial Watch with
detailed accounts, reports, diagrams, and photos of the situation
which is terrorizing residents in a once harmonious Arizona town just
a few miles from Mexico. They blame the Biden administration’s
catastrophic open border policies for the serious problems that have
gripped the area in the last few years.

subject: Ok now I’m even more worried
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
We have a lot of work to do between now and November.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240710-2&t=1&akid=932%2E587540%2EAC5CXd)
**Now I'm really worried, Peter**. I’m sure you’ve seen the recent headlines:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240710-2?refcode=em20240710-2&amount=5&refcode2=932_587540_AC5CXd&akid=932%2E587540%2EAC5CXd)
[**This is why the work we’re doing at Leaders We Deserve is so important. I’m about to explain why, but first – can you donate $5 to join us in the fight?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240710-2?refcode=em20240710-2&amount=5&refcode2=932_587540_AC5CXd&akid=932%2E587540%2EAC5CXd)
**President Biden’s support is eroding in critical battleground states, especially among young and nonwhite voters.** It’s an unfortunate reality, but if voters stay home in November, the likelihood of another Trump term increases dramatically.
We can’t control what happens at the top of the ticket – or truly know how accurate these polls are. But we do have an insurance policy for November regardless of the polls that the Republicans aren’t counting on: _young, progressive candidates running in pivotal districts all across the country._
Our endorsed candidates – like Bryce Berry and Ashwin Ramaswami in Georgia, Anna Thomas in Pennsylvania, and Oscar De Los Santos in Arizona – have the potential to inspire young people to vote this November. And the more voters they bring to the polls, the better the chances of Biden winning those same districts.
**Consider this, Peter:** President Biden only won Georgia by 11,779 votes in 2020.1 Ashwin is running in a state Senate district with a population that is 28% Asian American, according to Census data.2 As a young, progressive Indian American on the ballot, Ashwin could inspire thousands of new Democratic voters to the polls as he would be the first Indian American state legislator in Georgia state history. Ashwin could be the reason Biden keeps Georgia.
The same can be said for another of our candidates in Georgia: Bryce Berry, a middle school math teacher who would be the first Gen Z member of the Georgia House. As Biden struggles with young men of color in the polls, he could benefit from exciting candidates like Bryce running with him on the Democratic ticket.
I’m sure you’ve heard about candidates down the ballot “riding the coattails” of the presidential nominee – meaning that Democrats running for local and state offices need a strong candidate at the top of the ticket to get people out to vote.
👉 **We think the opposite can be true, as well**. President Biden can “ride the reverse coattails” of our bold, progressive candidates, all Gen-Z or Millennials, to victory. Candidates like Anna Thomas in PA who actually have the chance to prevent an abortion ban or the repeal of gun laws in their state. Your investment in these important local races is contributing to Biden’s reelection and protecting democracy from Trump’s march to authoritarianism.
**We have a lot of work to do between now and November, but I believe that we can get young people out to vote, elect a new generation of leaders, and stop Trump and his MAGA Republicans from taking over our government again.**
[**Peter, we’re doing everything we can to get young people to the polls and elect the leaders we deserve in November — but we can’t do it without your support. Will you pitch in $5 to Leaders We Deserve to make it happen?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240710-2?refcode=em20240710-2&amount=5&refcode2=932_587540_AC5CXd&akid=932%2E587540%2EAC5CXd)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240710-2?amount=5&refcode=em20240710-2-932&refcode2=932_587540_AC5CXd&akid=932%2E587540%2EAC5CXd)**
Thank you for your support,
**David Hogg**

**“New down payment assistance program for first-generation homebuyers aims to aid thousands” – Star Tribune**
Peter,
I wanted to share an exciting development that highlights our commitment to equity in making Minnesota the best state in the country to live, work, and raise a family in the country.
This week, my administration approved a $150 million fund to provide down payment assistance to first-generation homebuyers across Minnesota.

It's the team at Dr. Raul Ruiz for Congress HQ. Last week, we all watched as Donald Trump’s hand-picked Supreme Court granted him immunity from prosecution for “official” acts committed under his presidency. But that ruling overshadowed another — _equally as alarming_ — ruling handed down by the hyper-partisan court: **The destruction of the Chevron doctrine.** In short, the Chevron doctrine directed courts to defer to federal agencies like the FDA, EPA, and CDC on key issues that fell under their jurisdiction. But now, the courts have the final say on these issues — something that could prove incredibly disastrous for the environment, public health, safety, and MORE in the United States. As a physician and lifelong advocate for public health and safety, Dr. Ruiz understands the key role that experts within agencies like the FDA, EPA, and CDC play in safeguarding the American people and our environment.
But now that the courts have the final say on these issues, all that expertise may be ignored in favor of **ill-informed decisions motivated by hyper-partisanship and political gain.**

The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. While Washington remains gridlocked, Dr. Raul Ruiz is committed to serving and helping constituents with the problems they have with the federal government and cutting red tape. Last week, we all watched as Donald Trump’s hand-picked Supreme Court granted him immunity from prosecution for “official” acts committed under his presidency. But that ruling overshadowed another — equally as alarming — ruling handed down by the hyper-partisan court: The destruction of the Chevron doctrine. In short, the Chevron doctrine directed courts to defer to federal agencies like the FDA, EPA, and CDC on key issues that fell under their jurisdiction. But now, the courts have the final say on these issues — something that could prove incredibly disastrous for the environment, public health, safety, and MORE in the United States. | | | Instead of deferring to the experts within these agencies on decisions that could drastically affect our everyday lives, our nation’s courts — which lean largely conservative after Donald Trump appointed over one-third of our current federal judiciary — now have the power to make those decisions. As a physician and lifelong advocate for public health and safety, Dr. Ruiz understands the key role that experts within agencies like the FDA, EPA, and CDC play in safeguarding the American people and our environment. | | **For Immediate Release:** July 10, 2024

**Contact:** Griffin Reid, Communications Director, _**[greid@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop "greid@indiana.gop")**_

**_Democrat Nominee Jennifer McCormick Still Silent on Joe Biden’s Disastrous Debate, Cognitive Decline_** **INDIANAPOLIS, Ind. (July 10, 2024)** – Indiana Republican Party Communications Director Griffin Reid issued the following statement on Democrat nominee Jennifer McCormick's silence regarding President Biden's disastrous debate performance and cognitive decline: "Democrat nominee Jennifer McCormick still has not commented on the disastrous debate from the leader of her party, President Joe Biden. As national Democrats call for Biden to end his campaign after his obvious cognitive decline was on full display 13 days ago, Jennifer McCormick still has yet to answer if she thinks Biden is fit to serve as President or if she wants Biden at the top of the Indiana Democrat ticket with her in November. "This follows a pattern of McCormick refusing to answer basic questions about what she believes. She has not said if Joe Biden should resign the office of President after his cognitive decline became undeniable at the debate or if she still supports Biden at the top of her Democrat ticket. McCormick has not revealed if she will still vote for Joe Biden in November after the debate, and still has not revealed who she voted for in 2016 or 2020. "72% of American voters said Biden does not have the mental and cognitive health to serve as President following the June 27 debate in a [CBS poll.](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=22e98cd8504546fa8b60ab2d8b014344&_e=9_9wSw90fFqJjGCeX-SPHa8yTdNaM7dqKuGDl-qwZG-5U7JS7vZ-yJKzHCMFiRKxfwMyU3Nvr6UOQLZ1VbigtguwZK96yE0NV4ObvaxE7TWDAHHWIptM8AklhXmNHo8uSIWVTFMsXRc35uk-DYN6TqR88bgrGfAIacgnW1G7S8XYTt5bu2F_BvMQbyCfJr2Rat-wQFPgZ_o_evmxk50I24t6edqHfx7t04OOnRyBY3csSSQ99clMJOCXLW64A8uCoLvlTPnLexm1Gon2FBbvGLhBPYTXJ99N40b9eMaVqkM%3D) What does Jennifer McCormick think? No one knows. "Meanwhile, we all know where Sen. Braun stands, because he isn't afraid to share his true beliefs with Hoosiers, unlike McCormick." **Sen. Braun offered this reaction to the debate:** "Last night’s debate was a disaster for Joe Biden, who was lost and confused about how his extreme liberal policies have hurt Americans. President Trump showed he is focused and ready to end the crisis on the border, reverse the inflation crisis hurting Hoosier families, and enact bold America First solutions I’m running for Governor to bring to Indiana as well." **Just yesterday, Sen. Braun[had this to say](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=22e98cd8504546fa8b60ab2d8b014344&_e=9_9wSw90fFqJjGCeX-SPHU8_0JwSGbnhpFC9k4KPFJyuGeBfwMjZXE7Bh9thvG5UZPqneO1kPGDdDnk7x5k0L6o4G3FnPRINCw8ZpCW40cP0JnfP-8LoSyflptED6Yq83VBZjbo64taftGgczTZUOz5zLylO45LpEiPJ4Tz1YHNTcfqJbJRwtaZCHUkBgXNPeNLb0zNsQqUmL8bcGjWGz7alNZ7PldV1LFIpLe5O4oQ%3D) on Fox Business: ** “How can you have someone that is obviously showing these signs running the toughest business in the world - the federal government - with all the challenges that are out there?” ###

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

We know how very, very lucky we are to be Americans — and we see straight through the Left’s rhetoric about how horrible America is. **My family fled socialism before, and we’re NOT doing it again.****** It’s why I’ll keep fighting to preserve the American Dream. | | Fellow Patriot, I remember it like it was yesterday. My father was working in West Africa, and we were living there when radical Iranians invaded the U.S. embassy in Tehran.

As a precaution, the U.S. Marines brought all U.S. citizens and green card holders to the U.S. Embassy. The look on their eyes said _“_ _Nothing will happen to you tonight. Not on my watch”_

In that moment, I knew I wanted to be JUST like them. **I wanted to grow up and defend the country that gave safe harbor to me and my family.**
Fast forward ten years, and I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and served for 25 years as a Navy Special Operations Officer, retiring as a Captain.

There is no honor like serving your country, and I’m ready for a new capacity of service: **representing the Commonwealth of Virginia in the U.S. Senate.**

**[Before I tell you a little bit about why I’m running, would you consider pitching in a few bucks to our campaign?](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=51c2761f92814b3e9ea963545e79e068&_e=G0mb9DQT6n8Ow91GgvjZi8La0LU8PpZoCJSewtHvpUZLw38KLmfb72yqgbX3a-6vaF-cLwzWioxPaIC9LTGXynkscsOHBP2vyeqsmHNLDgyvlPyszHFucQYJkFbBYPCpZ5hzOeLyssdEV67px8yOZNflUMRbWnF1M09GfxcNjUpaDTzQV3pAFUAW1YqjNN6jb2vIJCI468QF2WfpcWgslf3lObK0WbtThihZaIudKfzGho5euJnN_oiTxi6tRD9X-1jGo1U5-AAZwSPSk48QcOVjOnnk0Krgz8dMlG_lGhFtHP0rS5eYMyScqBwc0hB_uje2amJ-d5lVJSvjF8iWAyfZTudWtYQmM4RFjtxVLGLGRwlx6c9L-hEul6ZurnBD)**

You see, there’s a Latin saying we like to use in the Navy: **“ Non sibi sed patriae.” It means “not self but country,” and it’s a phrase that’s foreign to too many of today’s politicians. **

Politicians like Tim Kaine have completely lost touch with the American people. They’d rather keep our borders wide open to criminals than take care of our veterans and our law-abiding citizens. They’re more interested in keeping special, high-dollar interests happy than serving the people who elected them.

As someone who dedicated my life to fighting for our country, it makes me absolutely sick.

I risked my life to keep America safe, and now, politicians like Tim Kaine are throwing away all of our servicemembers’ hard work.

body:
Every endorsement, donation, and everyday person like you sharing Lucas’ message could make all the difference this race.
#
Peter,
Social Security Works was the first national organization to endorse Lucas Kunce.
Weeks later, statewide labor unions like the Missouri AFL-CIO and the Missouri Fire Fighters made their earliest endorsements for a Senate challenger _ever_ by supporting Lucas’ campaign against Josh Hawley for this U.S. Senate seat.
In the months that followed, Lucas earned critical endorsements from former statewide leaders like Jason Kander, Joe Maxwell, and Susan Montee. And secured support from even more major national groups like League of Conservation Voters, End Citizens United, and VoteVets.
Now, Lucas has support from all 114 Missouri counties, and the city of St. Louis. He’s been endorsed by dozens of statewide and local labor unions across the state — last month, he was officially endorsed by the United Auto Workers.
**But Lucas still needs one very important endorsement — from you, Peter.**
**[Will you join the grassroots, worker-led coalition of tens of thousands of everyday people standing behind Lucas Kunce’s campaign for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat by adding your personal endorsement today?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/signup/lk-email-20240710-endorse-lucas/?t=1&akid=5975%2E614464%2E_AB__W)**
**[Add your endorsement »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/signup/lk-email-20240710-endorse-lucas/?t=2&akid=5975%2E614464%2E_AB__W)**
Lucas’ bold message of taking back power from corrupt politicians like Hawley is already resonating with Missouri voters — and all the GOP insiders propping up Hawley's campaign know it. So now, they’re determined to do, say, and spend whatever it takes to tear down Lucas and the grassroots movement we’re building together.
They know Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley this November — and that every endorsement, donation, and everyday person like you sharing Lucas’ message could make all the difference in this race. **That’s why we have to ask:**
**[Will you join our worker-led, people-powered movement to elect Lucas Kunce to Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat by adding your personal endorsement today? When you add your name, we send a signal to everyone watching our race that this movement is growing even stronger every day.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/signup/lk-email-20240710-endorse-lucas/?t=3&akid=5975%2E614464%2E_AB__W)**
**[Add your endorsement »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/signup/lk-email-20240710-endorse-lucas/?t=4&akid=5975%2E614464%2E_AB__W)**
It’s going to take an unprecedented amount of support from real people like you to elect Lucas, flip this seat, and take back power for everyday Missourians — and we’re so grateful that we’ve always been able to count on you, Peter.
Thanks for everything,
Team Lucas Kunce

Hi Friend,

**_I haven't introduced myself in a while, and I want you to know why I believe what I do._**

I spent my childhood in Middletown, Ohio, in a working-class family. I didn't have all the glamor that most people in politics have growing up; let me tell you, there were no silver spoons in our household.

I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw, and they taught me the nobility of hard work.

In my hometown, I saw my friend's parents hard at work in the factories. These same manufacturing jobs are now in danger of being ripped from our grasp because of China and bad trade deals absolutely destroying the manufacturing sector.

Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans. Career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. **They've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America.**

This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them.

It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support.

I didn't have all the glamor that most people in politics have growing up; let me tell you, there were no silver spoons in our household. I was raised by my Mamaw and Papaw, and they taught me the nobility of hard work. In my hometown, I saw my friend's parents hard at work in the factories. These same manufacturing jobs are now in danger of being ripped from our grasp because of China and bad trade deals absolutely destroying the manufacturing sector. Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans. Career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. They've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America. This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them. It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support. | Thank you, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans. During his tenures as Georgia's Secretary of State and Governor, Kemp has severely restricted access to the ballot box. His goal is clear: Maintain GOP power and reverse progress by silencing Georgians’ voices — especially Black, brown, and young voters. In his latest attempt to diminish our democracy, he signed legislation into law that will have the effect of disenfranchising thousands of voters during this crucial election year. Take a look at some (but not all) of Brian Kemp’s worst offenses as Voter Suppressor in Chief.= | = As Secretary of State from 2010 to 2018, Brian Kemp: ❌Said he was concerned with Democrats “registering all these minority voters”; ❌Investigated a Black city commissioner who assisted a first-time voter in understanding how to use voting machines; ❌Oversaw canceling more than 1.4 million voter registrations; ❌Put 53,000 voter registrations on hold before the 2018 election, nearly 70% of which were of Black voters; ❌Advised counties on how to close precincts and polling places, resulting in Georgia counties closing a total of 214 polling locations — a higher percentage closed than in any other state. Dear Friend,

You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.**

The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...

Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.
The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in "extremist ideologies" and having the potential for "domestic terrorism."
Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty.

Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below:

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b7cbfd915afa49c78fae4b8f27441a8f&_e=EGJ80mWAE-fMy_PPmnot8en5s-iNu4JXeEJtuYmZ__6ZY4CU8YlLJC0bSCYvKIv7YXxjO6JilGHGUP7BlkXXVM9TefGet5_6mnf0AjFp2uLygEp-s5u23lybLo3AEBKpZ1CDZ6Luq7_osJIMV1ZuQ7G5I8QQZrtv3WgnjhGBVJlWDHeu527KgY7bEZG8Bsi1OixwbNQa7q5ZMEaz3hAhouXShlgjdM0bb5fypc9wumMfufbq3evtJNeHKoJIPnyLC_3ps5Xr4Km81gGbCC9KhKjwscr5u-PTDzltiY-bML0Ry4YFhXKG8KFjYCQCBrZ8IgObgh4DhCcGxjojK27b1U852_ta0XdgLmRodeu_GqJSaf69lRaI7pKvIAuynlNonBexqYu3XzsFHpwNMe4j-RVp_VAk2aap10vEwIKBQII%3D)

Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."**

Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion."

These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties.

You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course.

**The first step is ...EDUCATION.**

Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.

That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.**

These efforts include:

**Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.**

I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b7cbfd915afa49c78fae4b8f27441a8f&_e=EGJ80mWAE-fMy_PPmnot8en5s-iNu4JXeEJtuYmZ__6ZY4CU8YlLJC0bSCYvKIv7YXxjO6JilGHGUP7BlkXXVM9TefGet5_6mnf0AjFp2uLygEp-s5u23lybLo3AEBKpZ1CDZ6Luq7_osJIMV1ZuQ7G5I8QQZrtv3WgnjhGBVJlWDHeu527KgY7bEZG8Bsi1OixwbNQa7q5ZMEaz3hAhouXShlgjdM0bb5fypc9wumMfufbq3evtJNeHKoJIPnyLC_3ps5Xr4Km81gGbCC9KhKfwlKgsx2Fvi2lSXV9WqwhO25-Gt9VdeKLiqsifId8vJe9urKIJopDUIGRMy-2lMJvPEOPfVVI2ziWtLaR61fwhRzdC5790gfDYLQkK6Mh9oL2DS-44icANFNoELRbz1tM9wefbsGMZ4iaKfAiu-os%3D)

Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Peter, I was born and raised in a small town in North Carolina, with 800 residents and zero traffic lights. My parents, a corrections officer and a social worker, instilled in me early on the importance of service and giving back where you can — something that I’ve held onto ever since. It’s a value I held throughout my undergraduate and law school career, and that I lived every day when I became the Legal Director of the ACLU of Virginia, where I fought tooth and nail to advocate for the civil rights and liberties of _all_ Virginians, regardless of political belief. I did the same when I was appointed by both Ralph Northam and Glenn Youngkin to work under their administrations. And it’s the same reason I’m running for Congress — to give the people of VA-01 — _all the people_ — the leadership they’ve been lacking with Rob Wittman for far too long. We don’t need someone who votes with Donald Trump over 90% of the time — we need someone who votes for our families, our small businesses, and the communities we are proud to call our own. I’m a mother, a wife, and a proud advocate for the change we need here at home and across the country. I know the issues because I’ve lived them — unlike my opponent who’s had “politician” on his resume for nearly 4 decades. Ever since the U.S. Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , Republicans have been working overtime to dismantle reproductive health care even further, state by state. As a result, the abortion access landscape is _constantly_ changing. As the senior director of communications research at EMILYs List, it's my job to stay up to date on where access stands in states like Pennsylvania. That's why I'm reaching out today, to give you an updated map of abortion access across the country: [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/88653675/484693498/-1706349631?sourceid=1054271&refcode=WTEFES23_20240710_BansUpdate_ND_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZTczZDk3ZC1mYzNlLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=F2ACOGgel6PKUHe1_NCjzOeEgO2oMNW17_fvqu6S4Vc=) **Peter, nearly _ one in three _American women of reproductive age live in a state where abortion is banned or mostly banned. **That's just the beginning for anti-choice Republicans.

While extremists across the country try to take America back to the dark ages, we have the power to fight back. And the numbers are in our favor, Peter. We _know_ the overwhelming majority of Americans are pro-choice. We _know_ that abortion access wins elections. _

Making dinner and taking calls before my evening events — that's just the reality of being a working mom, friend!
As my campaign starts cooking with gas (pun fully intended 😉), I find myself taking solace in the normal moments at home. Don't get me wrong, I love being on the campaign trail, too: Talking to voters, traveling around Florida, running a battleground Senate race — I don't take a second of it for granted.

But here's what I also don't take for granted, friend: dinners at home with my three kids and husband, Sundays playing dominoes with my mom, and conversations with my children about what's been going on at school.
I love being a parent. But parents all over our nation — perhaps you, too, friend — share the same sinking feeling right now: Our kids are growing up in a country with fewer freedoms than we had at their age.

_I'm in this race to protect, restore, and defend our freedoms. To fight for our democracy. _

Because my opponent, Sen. Rick Scott, is directly responsible for confirming Supreme Court justices who have eviscerated reproductive rights, weakened voting rights, and effectively green-lighted Donald Trump's ability to be a king above the law. **_Ya no más — enough is enough._**
This is our greatest opportunity to defeat extremist Rick Scott and protect our democracy. His approval rating sits at an abysmal 35%, with election experts calling him one of the most vulnerable GOP senators on the ballot. **With Florida likely deciding Senate control, I'm fighting with everything I have to win and ensure my kids — and all kids — grow up with every freedom and opportunity to achieve their American dream.**

Trust in government is crucial for the smooth functioning of our democracy and for the implementation of policies that reflect the will and welfare of the people. Do you trust the government? What factors influence your level of trust or distrust? Your insights and experiences would be invaluable in understanding the broader sentiment within our community. Your feedback is greatly appreciated in the comments on the video I am sharing in this video!! Thank you for taking the time to share your views. I look forward to hearing from you. ? Dan Carr (C) 2024 Dan Carr 18237 Hwy 53, Gulfport, MS 39503 ? ?

subject: House Republicans Just Passed the SAVE Act
body:
American elections are for American citizens, and nearly 80% of voters oppose illegal migrants voting in any U.S. election. | | | | |

|
## House Republicans just passed the **SAVE Act.**

What is the SAVE Act?
The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act would require "documentary proof of United States citizenship" to vote in federal elections.
**American elections are for American citizens** , and nearly 80% of voters oppose illegal migrants voting in any U.S. election.
---
[](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=89dbecd8c7&e=e907534017)
| As the Chairman of the Committee on House Administration, I was proud to pass this bill through our committee in May.
**Now, we’ve passed this bill through the House.**
This bill was common sense election integrity legislation.
There shouldn’t be anything controversial about ensuring only American citizens are voting in American elections. But Democrats fought hard to kill this bill.
---

This year, our district will be one of the most fiercely contested House races in the country. National Democrats are coming at me more aggressively than they have before and they’re sparing no expense.
If you’re able and willing, I would appreciate your help countering their attacks by donating to my campaign.

body:
The president has been busy.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_wars_around_the_world&n=1)
---
Peter,

Joe Biden submitted to a one-on-one interview with George Stephanopoulos the other day in an effort to dig out of his post-debate tailspin.

There was plenty in that interview that should be (and is) worrying even to the president’s staunchest supporters. But one moment in particular stood out to me:
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=biden_wars_around_the_world&n=2)
---
**Joe Biden just admitted he wasn’t prepared to face Trump because he’s been busy doing “wars around the world.”

** For all the talk about the president’s age and declining acuity, I found this to be a REMARKABLY clear statement of his priorities.

Of course we know how busy Biden has been. The worst of these “wars around the world” is Israel’s genocide in Gaza, armed and funded by our government at the unyielding insistence of Joe Biden himself.

**Sorry Joe, you can’t tell us democracy is on the ballot while you’re supplying bombs to a fascist apartheid state and facilitating the extermination of an entire people.

** The vast majority of Americans want an END to Israel’s bloodlust and a permanent ceasefire for Palestine. I’ve been an anti-war activist all my life, and **I’m running for president to dismantle the American war machine.

| | The opioid epidemic is devastating Northwest Washington, so for the last six months, I have dedicated time and resources to tackling this crisis in our communities. **First, I released a report that analyzes the ongoing opioid epidemic.** Here are some of the topline findings:
* From February 2022 - February 2023, Washington state had the largest percentage increase of drug overdose deaths in the United States.
* In the five counties in our district – Island, San Juan, Skagit, Snohomish, and Whatcom – most overdose deaths can be attributed to synthetic opioids like fentanyl.
* In 2022, upwards of 75% of Washington's total drug overdose deaths were linked to opioids.
* Broadly, the United States saw a 3% decline in overdose deaths overall during this year-long period. But at home in Washington, deaths increased by more than 21%, continuing devastating trends which began during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic.

* Preventing individuals from turning to opioids;
* Interdicting the flow of opioids into communities;
* Expanding treatment; and
* Supporting long-term recovery for individuals and building resilience in local communities.

body:
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1229%2E791427%2EvbYCX9)

Hey team, it's Ilhan. I'm writing to ask you to **[add your name to say you personally endorse my campaign for Congress in Minnesota's 5th district,**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july24-personal-endorse/?source=em240710-2-NOR&refcode2=1229.791427.vbYCX9&akid=1229%2E791427%2EvbYCX9) but before I explain why your support today is so important to our movement, let me start at the very beginning.
Now, one thing you may know about my story is that I am a refugee.
When I was just a young child, my family was forced to escape civil war in Somalia and take sanctuary in a Kenyan refugee camp for four years.
We didn't always have food, or running water. But we did have a dream that one day, we would be able to get out of that camp and start a new life in the United States.
At the time, I couldn't have imagined that someday, I would run for office in a new country, nevermind become the first African-born member of Congress, or that tens of thousands of people would stand with me along the way.
When I got to Washington, my colleagues and the political establishment told me that I was destined to fail, and that two years later we'd run again and lose. They said a Somali, Muslim, hijab-wearing, Black progressive woman couldn’t enact change in an institution with rules not created for us.
But we did not back down. We fought hard for our ideas. We forced climate action to the top of the agenda. We empowered Medicare to finally negotiate prescription drug prices. We made justice in all its forms a priority.
Then we ran again, and won. And once more after that, for good measure.
But the truth is, we still have a great deal of work ahead of us. The insiders and special interests who never wanted me in Congress are going to come back with more money and resources than ever before to try to take me down here in 2024.
**I know that I cannot fight back against them alone. That is something that is going to require ALL of us.**
**[So I'm asking you to stand with me today. Will you add your name to personally endorse our re-election campaign? Building this movement is something we must all do together.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july24-personal-endorse/?source=em240710-2-NOR&refcode2=1229.791427.vbYCX9&akid=1229%2E791427%2EvbYCX9)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july24-personal-endorse/?source=em240710-2-NOR&refcode2=1229.791427.vbYCX9&akid=1229%2E791427%2EvbYCX9)**
When I was first elected to Congress in 2018, our ideas were called radical:
* 🏥 Medicare for All
* 🌅 A Green New Deal
* 📈 Raising the Minimum Wage
* 🎓 Canceling Student Debt
* ❌ Banning Assault Weapons

Together, our progressive movement made these ideas mainstream. We demanded an economy that works for the many, not the few. All of us — and especially young people — deserve a country that lives up to her promise of justice for all.
There’s no doubt that these ideas have put a constant target on me from Republicans and their corporate allies. The DC insiders and special interests that thrive on the status quo have come after me nonstop. Every two years, they recruit another challenger who will fall in line with their agenda, and their super PACs flood my district with millions of dollars in dark money to try to silence all of us.
They are already preparing to do it again here in 2024. Right-wing groups like AIPAC and their United Democracy super PAC have committed to spending _$100 million_ nationwide interfering in Democratic primaries.
But I didn’t come to Congress to be silent. I came to Congress to be a voice for you. For working families. For little girls like me. And for those who have felt ignored or silenced for too long.
**Today, I need you to add your voice to mine as we prepare for the fights ahead. What do you say?**
**[Please use this link and add your name to personally endorse our re-election for Congress today. I need as many people as possible to stand with me in this campaign.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-july24-personal-endorse/?source=em240710-2-NOR&refcode2=1229.791427.vbYCX9&akid=1229%2E791427%2EvbYCX9)**
It may seem like a small and simple action, but it speaks volumes about our collective power. Thank you for signing on today.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

Hi Peter,
It’s been a busy start to the summer, especially since we were all hands on deck in June to hit our quarterly fundraising goal.
We wanted to send along some highlights from the campaign trail from the last couple of months, which you can see below!
As this race heats up, your support is more important than ever. You can help us flip this seat blue by chipping in here >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_071024_Recap_act]

The Pima County Democratic Party’s Udall Dinner was a big success. Both Udall brothers once held this seat, and Kirsten will be proud to continue their legacies of environmental conservation and good governance in office.

Our campaign hosted reproductive healthcare advocates Kaitlyn Joshua, Amanda Zurawski, Amy Fitch-Heacock, and Tucson's very own State Rep. Stephanie Stahl Hamilton for a roundtable discussion. Their heartbreaking stories are a reminder of why abortion access is so important.

Team Engel ran the TMC Meet Me Downtown 5k. This race is extra special in our community, as it honors Gabe Zimmerman, a Tucson native whose incredible life was cut short by senseless gun violence.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_071024_Recap_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_071024_Recap_act]
The Bisbee Pride Parade was a wonderful celebration of love, equality, and Arizona’s LGBTQ+ community.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_071024_Recap_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_071024_Recap_act]

We canvassed all over our district the weekend before the second anniversary of the Dobbs Supreme Court decision. At one of the doors, Kirsten met George, an independent who is concerned that politicians want to control women’s bodies — and who will be voting for Kirsten this November!
Kirsten says it all the time: we have the best supporters in the world, and none of this would be possible without you.
There’s no sugarcoating it: this is a tough race. It’s a toss-up, and every door we knock on, every voter we talk to, and every sign we put up makes a difference.
With less than four months until the election, we need your support more than ever. Can you chip in now to help Kirsten win this race? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_071024_Recap_act]

DONATE MONTHLY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_071024_Recap_act&recurring=1]

Onwards,
Engel HQ

She’s ready to take that fight to Washington to find common-sense solutions to the challenges we’re facing here in Arizona's Sixth Congressional District.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: A pretty wild story, if you have a minute
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
Hola Derek. It's Ruben.

You might be wondering how this kid...

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_gallego.a_Bhcs&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240710_PM1_V1_S1&t=1003&akid=6993%2E5257348%2EL_ZzXM ]Ruben Gallego as a baby

...ended up here, running for U.S. Senate, in one of the most competitive
races in the entire country.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_gallego.a_Bhcs&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240710_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=6993%2E5257348%2EL_ZzXM ]Ruben speaking to a crowd

Well, it started back in the apartment I shared with my mom and my sisters
after our dad left. It was tough. I was sleeping on the floor because
that’s all we could afford.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_gallego.a_Bhcs&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240710_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=6993%2E5257348%2EL_ZzXM ]Ruben and his sisters

I knew I had to do whatever it took to build a better life for us. I
worked a bunch of jobs all through school to help make ends meet.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_gallego.a_Bhcs&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240710_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=6993%2E5257348%2EL_ZzXM ]Ruben working in a fast food establishment

Thanks to my family, my community, and a lot of hard work, I got into
college. But before I graduated, I enlisted in the Marines to serve the
country that gave me so much.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_gallego.a_Bhcs&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240710_PM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=6993%2E5257348%2EL_ZzXM ]Ruben in Iraq

I deployed to Al Anbar, Iraq with my brothers in arms. They called us
“Lucky Lima,” but our luck turned eventually. We ended up the hardest
Marine hit unit of the entire Iraq war, and I lost some of my best friends
over there.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_gallego.a_Bhcs&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240710_PM1_V1_S1&t=1008&akid=6993%2E5257348%2EL_ZzXM ]Ruben and his military friends holding an American flag

You’re never the same person after something like that. And I knew I had
to do something to improve things for the guys I served with, for people
who grew up like me. So, I ended up running for Congress — and I won.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_gallego.a_Bhcs&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240710_PM1_V1_S1&t=1009&akid=6993%2E5257348%2EL_ZzXM ]Ruben speaking to a crowd

Then, on January 6th, everything changed. It became clear to me that
public service wasn’t just about improving the lives of the people in my
community anymore — it was about defending our democracy, too.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_gallego.a_Bhcs&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240710_PM1_V1_S1&t=1010&akid=6993%2E5257348%2EL_ZzXM ]Ruben Gallego standing on a chair

So now, I’m running for U.S. Senate. My opponent Kari Lake continues to
spread the same lies and conspiracies that caused January 6th in the first
place, and she’s one of the greatest threats to our democracy — after
Trump himself.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_gallego.a_Bhcs&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240710_PM1_V1_S1&t=1011&akid=6993%2E5257348%2EL_ZzXM ]Kari Lake and Donald Trump

Back when I was that kid sleeping on the floor of our apartment, I never
would’ve guessed this is how things would turn out.

When I was a Marine in Iraq, I never would’ve thought I’d have to fight to
defend our democracy at home.

When I launched my first campaign, I never would’ve imagined that hundreds
of thousands of people would back me up and donate to support me, either.

And I never ever would’ve thought I’d need to ask supporters like you,
people who have already done so much, to do a bit more. But to defeat Kari
Lake and win in Arizona, that’s what I have to do.

I need you to do a bit more.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1230?c0=july2024_abs_em_gallego.dYg34m&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240710_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1012&akid=6993%2E5257348%2EL_ZzXM ]Please — if you can afford to make a split donation of $5 or anything
you can to my campaign and Adam Schiff’s, it would mean the world. A
fundraising deadline is right around the corner, and we’ve got a ton of
progress to make on our goals between now and then.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split

It is clear President Biden is forcing us to spend money protecting our candidate and not on national grassroots advertising or voter outreach.

Right now, America's biggest adversaries are working to surpass our nation's military capabilities. And critical problems exist in many areas of the world:
* Countries like Iran act deceitfully and use their military to bully other countries.

* Rogue states like North Korea and Syria pose direct threats to their regions and America's security.

* And the leaders of countries like China and Russia have proven they will do whatever they can to increase government control and state surveillance of their citizens.

On top of all this, our country's military equipment--including planes, tanks, and ships--is decades-old and years past its useful service.

With information like this, you would think our elected leaders would push to ensure a strong future for our nation's military. But some of them are actually looking to reduce America's defense spending. Apparently, they would rather prioritize issues like climate change.

That's why I'm emailing you today.

I'm told that you are a conservative who wants to ensure that our country remains a beacon of hope, opportunity, and liberty for all the world. And I understand that you are just as concerned as I am about the future of America's defense.

[So, today, I want to make sure you get a FREE copy of The Heritage Foundation's _2024 Index of U.S. Military Strength_.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9f501ed7357f4dc5b3e71096e7f2b208&_e=LNdo6EWCmXItG9kP-44ELUPTv_ll9w5a_72QR5goHkb5g_lkn8hsWTwTjmwZ1neCxpKY3mSiA6II1mUxo1DaGnd7__2splZyPWm-eR2gCI60RbkWTu_6J-adx7GnaNOXDSQ36L8p7e_APnf5P1f-BPmLIA_WAb3uudPgwmQ8bq_FdL094-32s-AGzddvW5UM1Tj8lkvsqOlQ0ZYj47flhsHAUT5RM9Kk5INKH6OQirkMDvQbqj1phIvblS0if-Z-PSqOYKMgwohqA_ickg0tiMdyjYHeknBA1dOmDX8abFtZvmfAh1Pjx7DjmEeKltEMEeQ5JH0_97pLgZfoYKiJ9GMRC0XCgYVcrr48AdCntdI3i5n-v0zI0Y-Qf-_kt4yM)

We publish this report to help decision-makers in government see how conditions have evolved in the past year and where American strengths, challenges, and opportunities for improvement lie.

But we also make this important resource available to the general public, so that you are aware of how well--or poorly--the government is handling this sacred task.

In addition to all of this, you can use this Index to explore topics like:
* Understanding risk in the great competition with the Chinese Communist Party.

* What we risk if we fail to fully modernize the U.S. nuclear deterrent.

* How prioritizing climate change and DEI training weakens America's military.

**You can get instant access to your FREE guide right now using this secure link:** [https://secured.heritage.org/us-military-strength-ebook/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9f501ed7357f4dc5b3e71096e7f2b208&_e=LNdo6EWCmXItG9kP-44ELUPTv_ll9w5a_72QR5goHkb5g_lkn8hsWTwTjmwZ1neCxpKY3mSiA6II1mUxo1DaGnd7__2splZyPWm-eR2gCI60RbkWTu_6J-adx7GnaNOXDSQ36L8p7e_APnf5P1f-BPmLIA_WAb3uudPgwmQ8bq_FdL094-32s-AGzddvW5UM1Tj8lkvsqOlQ0ZYj47flhp1F4M-U_9HiMcInG0akJK5P2xRD8XvdQEIQyl2O30xh4snBu5aDY3S25kVtilmeWKD_hnYvea1-YFUbGL2pGJyrq0zq76Lsoc3GE0hFspENX0uXM3wc2cTH09dEx_xld8qzuWjh8EWjBoLUCqWv4m1ftxmsGQyTbSjVrfIfiGzg).

| | Hi friend – it’s Janelle. On the campaign trail, I get asked all the time why I’m running for Congress. It’s a fair question, so I wanted to reach out, personally, to explain exactly why I entered this race. **[If you don’t have time to read the rest of my note (that’s okay!), can I count on you to pitch in a few dollars to our grassroots campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88659688/484713740/-434018290?amount=3&refcode=em_fr_2024.07.10_b1_jb_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmZiNTdlZmYtMGIzZi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=_I2ImirviNPjCwpHRJO_044lSc7fkzRCUJImgWBEFA4=)** **I’m running for Congress because, like many of you, I want my children to inherit a better world than the one I grew up in.** You see, my mom first encouraged me to run for office saying "If your generation doesn't stand up and fight, we stand to lose the progress my generation worked for." She was right, friend. subject: We have a problem. A big one.

body:
The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control – and ramming through any radical policy he wants – is just a few competitive House seats.
I briefed President Trump on America’s most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

| |

---
| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Joe Biden and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Joe Biden having full control - and ramming through any radical policy he wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

_**[That's why I'm rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=9dae9ebc401e42abaa8950467087645d&_e=SKZneapy7PTBUYbumysAUhx2uFBEiZjBjfK9kWAXrwmEKl_y_y0jIpJ2Jmb7pUJu_PhIqYAqJAUoC0-D5Te9aEqi6a8CnZtRnO1Y5-vhnPkOA3LHJv7rq8tX-du0vs65W45WkzXSTDMeNXkEJTJ6eMTFE0D-_UchpMCXm1jY9IcycxkJcyn-RpvCv_cYM2t9bAe5JpuLo1aCMwToWIiaCBVZGR2nlDUXKxmeqJCWBgMfBmy_lOf5r48ehtiniX68nD2fFzxu65JB8byR-VdQqWnQU72QwYyQa4db3kxjvl6kOG2G_N5MpZVKsksD45hLF6Nn--CLQIzFag_53onVpyBGWV7MZJf02u9xuCMQX8V5fQNJD2wnYg6f4oy15gYuKBs7WTi265U7nO6M1kB6qA%3D%3D "That’s why I’m rushing to you, in partnership with Majority Leader Steve Scalise, to raise a game-changing one million dollars in the next 72 hours.")**_ I know what you're thinking... that's not enough runway to raise that much. But desperate times call for desperate measures. And if that's what it'll take to win, I'm willing to chase down every lead.

If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Will you do what it takes to hand Joe Biden and the Democrats a humiliating defeat?

I wish I had better news, Peter, but Republican spending is making a difference in this Senate race.

$20 million (and counting...) has already been spent on ads in Wisconsin by my Republican opponent, Eric Hovde, and his allies — including not one, but FIVE different right-wing super PACs.

Just last month, Donald Trump held his third MAGA rally of the year in our state, where he uplifted my opponent and rallied his far-right base in support of his campaign.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Can I please make a case for your support?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1637%2E135344%2Ej8eNkG)

Friend --
In just a few days, we’ll close the books on the last official FEC deadline of our campaign before the general election.
With your permission, I’d appreciate the chance to make the case for why a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate is one of the most strategic contributions you can make today.
Let me start with what you probably already instinctively know: Michigan is going to be a critical state for the 2024 campaign.
There is no winning the White House without Michigan. For Democrats, there is no holding the Senate without Michigan. Even our House delegation rests on a one-seat Democratic majority.
But you were probably already sold on the importance of Michigan. So, aside from the fact that control of the U.S. Senate is at stake (!), what about my race? Why donate to my campaign?
This is one of the rare open Senate races without an incumbent running -- in fact, it’s one of the few competitive races in the entire country. That means we have A LOT of introducing of me to do across the state. A recent poll showed about 50% of the state knows me, across our 11 media markets.
Reaching those folks takes resources, and that's not something I can do without you.

**Why These Races Matter**
The recent legislative session in Michigan saw monumental progress on key issues, especially in clean energy and environmental reforms. Clean energy legislation was passed, setting a 100% clean energy standard by 2040 and establishing policies for energy efficiency and environmental justice. They also eliminated “polluter panels” and took significant steps to protect children from lead poisoning.
In addition to this major progress on climate policy, they passed critical legislation on other key issues, from increasing protections for workers across the state, to ensuring access to healthcare, and protecting LGBTQ+ communities from discrimination.
But here’s the deal: The majorities in both chambers are razor-thin — **just two seats** in each — which puts climate progress at risk. Extreme Republicans and even some Democrats are campaigning to undo many of these accomplishments. Our endorsed candidates are the champions we need to keep Michigan leading the way on climate progress.
**Investing in these races will have ripple effects beyond the state.** The climate crisis doesn’t respect state lines; the policies Michigan enacts will impact your air, water, and environment, regardless of where you live.

Jenn Hill, Donavan McKinney, Dylan Wegela, and Jaime Churches are on the front lines of the climate fight, and they need our support to win their primaries on August 6th. = | = Why These Races Matter The recent legislative session in Michigan saw monumental progress on key issues, especially in clean energy and environmental reforms. Clean energy legislation was passed, setting a 100% clean energy standard by 2040 and establishing policies for energy efficiency and environmental justice. They also eliminated “polluter panels” and took significant steps to protect children from lead poisoning. In addition to this major progress on climate policy, they passed critical legislation on other key issues, from increasing protections for workers across the state, to ensuring access to healthcare, and protecting LGBTQ+ communities from discrimination. But here’s the deal: The majorities in both chambers are razor-thin — just two seats in each — which puts climate progress at risk. Extreme Republicans and even some Democrats are campaigning to undo many of these accomplishments. Our endorsed candidates are the champions we need to keep Michigan leading the way on climate progress. Investing in these races will have ripple effects beyond the state. The climate crisis doesn’t respect state lines; the policies Michigan enacts will impact your air, water, and environment, regardless of where you live. Meet Our Climate Champions = Jenn Hill: Jenn is running for re-election to the Michigan House of Representatives to represent District 109. She is a proven leader for our environment and is leading Michigan toward a clean energy future. She isn’t afraid to hold corporate polluters accountable and will always put her constituents first. Her legislative accomplishments, including the state’s historic clean energy package, underscore her commitment to a clean, green future. = Donavan McKinney: Donavan is running for re-election to the Michigan House of Representatives to represent District 11. He fought to pass Michigan’s historic clean energy package and has been an outspoken opponent of dangerous fossil fuel infrastructure like Line 5. Dylan is working to level the playing field and prohibit investor-owned utilities from using dark money to influence elections. = Jaime Churches: Jaime is running for re-election to the Michigan House of Representatives to represent District 27. name: Katie Porter
subject: A constituent of mine
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Truth to Power PAC
body:
Eric Hovde is a Republican banker from Orange County...who’s running for Senate in Wisconsin.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38974%2E3422442%2EWIuVRZ)
Derek,
I want to tell you about one of my constituents. His name is Eric Hovde, and he’s a Republican multi-millionaire from Orange County. He owns a major bank (based in Irvine) and lives in a $7 million mansion (in Laguna Beach, right on the ocean).
Eric Hovde lives, works, and sleeps in my district, CA-47. **But he’s running for Senate...in Wisconsin? 🤨**
Don’t worry—I’m also confused. Eric is running against Tammy Baldwin, Wisconsin’s Democratic senator and a champion in the fight against special interests. **Come on, Eric...**
**[Will you split a donation between Tammy’s campaign and my organization, Truth to Power, to make sure that Eric makes it back to Orange County this fall?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240710-baldwin?refcode=em20240710-38974&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38974_3422442_WIuVRZ&akid=38974%2E3422442%2EWIuVRZ)**
Tammy believes we need to ban members of Congress from trading stocks. She wants to overturn _Citizens United_. And, she’s introduced legislation that would stop the revolving door between Washington and big corporations. **It’s difficult to think of a stronger voice against corruption in the Senate.**
But, there’s a real chance that Eric Hovde could unseat Tammy this November. And, the truth is that if Tammy loses her seat, Democrats will almost certainly lose the Senate.
**As we face the threat of a second Trump presidency, protecting our Senate majority has never been more important.**

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: What I saw in Wisconsin and Minnesota
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This is how we ensure the right to an abortion in Massachusetts and around the country.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2265%2E4032634%2E2X8r9l)
---
This year, I’m running for re-election to continue the fight for Massachusetts families in the U.S. Senate. Sometimes, that fight looks like delivering billions of dollars in federal funding for infrastructure upgrades in our Commonwealth. Or securing emergency funds to keep child care centers open when the pandemic started. Or cutting the costs of hearing aids. Or taxing big freeloading corporations to help pay for tackling the climate crisis. And sometimes, that fight looks like campaigning for other Democrats across the country. Because here’s the way I see it: our future in Massachusetts — and in every state across the country — depends on whether we protect our Senate majority. | [](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2418?t=8&akid=2265%2E4032634%2E2X8r9l)
---
Because if Republicans take back power — and they’re fighting tooth and nail for it — they are coming after abortion everywhere in this country. They're coming after IVF in this country, and they're coming after contraception — birth control, IUDs, Plan B, everything. Not just in red states, but nationally — red states, blue states, purple states, everywhere.
So on the two-year anniversary of the Supreme Court overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , I was in Wisconsin talking about how we can codify abortion rights across the country with a new federal law, but only if we re-elect President Biden with a pro-choice Democratic Congress. And defending our Senate majority requires re-electing my friend Senator Tammy Baldwin, who’s in a highly competitive re-election race in the state.
[](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2418?t=9&akid=2265%2E4032634%2E2X8r9l)
---
Then I kept up the fight with a swing through Minnesota to rally Democratic voters for Joe Biden and talk about what we need to do to protect abortion rights and save our democracy.
And I kept talking with dedicated volunteers who know that everything is on the line this year. They know how powerfully important it is to take every possible action between now and November to secure victory. They also know they’re not alone — they’re fighting alongside you and people all over America.
[](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2418?t=10&akid=2265%2E4032634%2E2X8r9l)
---
**[If it makes sense for you right now, will you show you’re in that fight by making a donation of $28 or any amount? I’m doing everything I possibly can to protect abortion rights in Massachusetts, Wisconsin, Minnesota, and every single state in our country, and your support ensures we can keep up this fight through November.](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2418?amount=28&t=11&akid=2265%2E4032634%2E2X8r9l)**
